new_roles.title: Director, Advanced Manufacturing Engineering
new_roles.description:
Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the development and execution of the Electrical Infrastructure division's manufacturing technology strategy to support growth, operational excellence, and financial performance. This role drives the identification, industrialization, and deployment of advanced manufacturing technologies, including automation, robotics, machine vision, controls, and digital manufacturing systems. Responsibilities include developing multi-year manufacturing roadmaps, leading capital investment planning, establishing engineering and equipment standards, and overseeing high-impact manufacturing initiatives. The Director partners with Operations, Finance, and business leaders to improve safety, quality, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

Legrand is the global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures. Its comprehensive offering of solutions for residential, commercial, and datacenter markets makes it a benchmark for customers worldwide.

Bridging power from sources to pathways to touchpoints, Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division combines innovation and quality to provide leading solutions for an evolving energy landscape. Our expertly designed products enable customers to confidently address the complex needs and challenges of electrification, while enhancing everyday experiences like plugging in, switching on, and staying connected. Committed to best-in-class service at every stage, we act as a trusted partner for our customers to ensure each project's success and their continued satisfaction. Legrand's Electrical Infrastructure division includes the following brands and product lines: Girtz, Avtron, Power Bus Way, Cablofil, Connectrac, Wiremold and Pass & Seymour.

Legrand, North & Central America offers comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as distinctive benefits like a high employer 401K match, paid time off (PTO) and holiday pay, short-term and long-term disability benefit plans, above-benchmark paid maternity and parental leave, bonus opportunities in accordance with the Company's incentive plans, paid time off to volunteer, and an active/growing Employee Resource Group network. For more information, visit legrand.us.

**At a Glance**

**Legrand**
has an exciting opportunity for a
**Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering**
to join the
**Electrical Infrastructure division.**
This leader identifies, develops, industrializes, and scales manufacturing processes, automation, autonomation, equipment, and digital capabilities that improve safety, quality, service, productivity, capacity, and flexibility across the manufacturing network.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering advises, develops, and executes operational business strategies with the VP of Operations and EI division Leadership Team in support of EI growth and financial goals. Those strategies include footprint and capacity expansion, factory roles, insourcing/outsourcing, operating constraints, and growth enablement into a multiyear manufacturing technology roadmap. The role provides technical leadership for significant manufacturing investments, establishes common engineering and equipment standards, and ensures solutions are economically justified, successfully industrialized, and deliver sustained operating and financial results.

The Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering is expected to determine when advanced technology creates differentiated value and when a simpler process, equipment, maintenance, sourcing, or product solution is more appropriate.

This position leads a focused technical organization that works through plant resources, internal partners, equipment suppliers, and qualified integrators.

**What Will You Do?**

**Manufacturing Technology Strategy**

* Develop and maintain a multiyear advanced manufacturing roadmap aligned with business strategy, factory roles, product requirements, capacity needs, and footprint plans.
* Evaluate and deploy appropriate manufacturing technologies, including automation, autonomation, robotics, machine vision, controls, advanced tooling, and digital manufacturing systems.
* Identify manufacturing capabilities the division should protect, build, standardize, modernize, source externally, or retire.
* Adapt technology strategies to differences in product complexity, volume, mix, demand stability, and operating model.

**Opportunity Portfolio and Investment Leadership**

* Build and prioritize a network-wide portfolio of advanced manufacturing, automation, and equipment-modernization opportunities.
* Define the operating loss or constraint being addressed, credible alternatives, expected business impact, investment requirement, lifecycle cost, risk, payback, and sustainment requirements.
* Determine when technology creates differentiated value and when process redesign, tooling, equipment refurbishment, maintenance improvement, outsourcing, product redesign, or another solution is more appropriate.
* Serve as the division's technical authority for significant manufacturing technology and equipment investments.
* Support footprint, make-versus-buy, capacity, and capital-allocation decisions with clear technical facts and alternatives.
* Lead the division governance process for manufacturing capital planning and deployment, providing consolidated visibility to investment requirements, approvals, timing, expenditure, implementation risk, and expected benefits.
* Partner with Operations, business General Managers, and Finance to develop and maintain a prioritized multi-year manufacturing plan.
* Monitor the deployment of approved manufacturing investments and escalate material risks involving scope, cost, schedule, technical performance, plant readiness, or benefit realization.

**Technical Industrialization and Standards**

* Establish standards for manufacturing equipment, automation, controls, tooling, data connectivity, safety, maintainability, and industrialization.
* Lead technical reviews of equipment specifications, process concepts, integrator selection, designs, risk assessments, acceptance testing, process capability, documentation, training, and critical spares.
* Ensure new processes incorporate quality at source, error-proofing, equipment reliability, operator safety, cybersecurity, and appropriate performance visibility.
* Establish preferred technology platforms, reusable equipment concepts, and qualified supplier and integrator networks where standardization creates value.

**Deployment and Sustainable Results**

* Lead the technical delivery of selected high-value, high-risk, or highly replicable manufacturing initiatives.
* Define when central AME involvement is required and when plant teams can execute within established standards.
* Establish clear ownership for technical development, plant readiness, commissioning, production ramp, and ongoing sustainment.
* Transfer solutions to plant ownership after safety, capability, reliability, training, documentation, maintenance, and performance requirements have been met.
* Conduct post-implementation reviews to verify that operating and financial benefits are achieved and sustained.
* Capture lessons learned and creates replication methods for proven solutions.

**Organization and Capability Development**

* Build and develop a high-performance advanced manufacturing engineering team with the technical depth required to support the division's strategy.
* Define which capabilities should be retained internally and which should be accessed through plants, internal partners, equipment suppliers, engineering firms, or system integrators.
* Establish expectations for supplier and integrator performance, documentation, intellectual property, lifecycle support, and reuse of developed solutions.
* Develop plant technical capability to minimize long-term dependence on central resources or external partners.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical field.

**Experience:**

* At least 10 years of progressive experience in advanced manufacturing engineering, automation, process engineering, or industrialization, including five years leading technical teams or multisite programs.
* Demonstrated experience in automation, robotics, autonomation, controls, machine vision, advanced tooling, or manufacturing data systems.
* Experience with equipment specifications, integrator management, design reviews, acceptance testing, commissioning, capability validation, and production handoff.
* Broad manufacturing-process knowledge and experience in both high-mix and higher-volume environments.
* Proven record of turning manufacturing technology investments into sustained operating and financial results.

**Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:**

* Strong understanding of capital economics, lifecycle cost, capacity analysis, labor impact, and benefit realization.
* Ability to translate operating losses and business requirements into prioritized technical opportunities.
* Ability to determine when advanced technology is appropriate and when a simpler operational solution will create greater value.
* Ability to translate technical complexity into clear business decisions and influence across a matrixed organization.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Finance, Product Engineering, Quality, EHS, HR, IT, Supply Chain, Lean, and PMO teams.
* Strong supplier, equipment manufacturer, and system-integrator management capabilities.
* Ability to balance enterprise standardization with legitimate differences across products, processes, plants, and operating models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical professionals, develop organizational capability, and operate effectively across multiple businesses and manufacturing locations.

new_roles.description:
**Position Title:**
Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering

**Location:**
Milwaukee, WI

**Position Summary:**

*Join a rapidly growing and market leading manufacturer as the Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering. Under the direction of and reporting to the VP of Manufacturing, the Director of Advanced Manufacturing Engineering leads the Manufacturing Engineering function and is accountable for five connected processes:*

* *Standard documentation and engineering change order (ECO) execution*
* *Manufacturing process and technology development in support of New Product Development (NPD), ensuring new products are designed for scalable, repeatable manufacturing*
* *Core technology capital equipment life cycle strategy, including the multi-year roadmap for acquiring, standardizing, deploying, and retiring manufacturing equipment for forming and finishing*
* *Manufacturing system design (MSD) including layout, line balance, material flow, and cell design*
* *Sustainment engineering in support of the value streams.*

*Core technology and MSD are developed in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing, and sustainment priorities are set with the Director of Manufacturing and the value stream leaders. The role leads the Manufacturing Team and partners with Design Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Finance, and Maintenance/Continuous Improvement.*

**Responsibilities:**

Engineering Change Order (ECO) Execution & Engineering Process Standards

* Own execution of the engineering change order (ECO) process end to end — intake, cross-functional impact review, approval routing, and implementation and cutover tracking — across fabrication and assembly, delivered through the Manager, NPD & Standard Documentation and the ECO resources reporting to that manager.
* Define and maintain manufacturing engineering process standards (BOM, routing, and work-instruction data integrity; drawing and specification standards; standard work definitions) and ensure they are consistently applied across value streams.
* Partner with Value Stream/Area Managers on the floor to ensure engineering standards are followed and gaps are closed, including standard-work sustainment audits, with sustaining engineers providing technical support through the Sustainment Lead.
* Participate in engineering design reviews; evaluate and approve standards for drawings, routings, specifications, and other manufacturing engineering documents.
* Provide the engineering-standards backbone that CI initiatives draw on when Value Stream/Area Managers and sustaining engineers pursue process improvements.

New Product Manufacturing Process Development

* Serve as the manufacturing engineering technology lead within the SOP-2 stage-gate process for new product programs, with primary focus on Phases P0–P2 (Business Case, Concept Design, Design Verification) — evaluating process technology options, make/buy decisions, and automation feasibility ahead of Beta Build — delivered through the Manager, NPD and the NPD engineers.
* Partner with Design Engineering during concept and design verification to ensure new products are designed for manufacturability (DFM/DFA), influencing product design before it is locked.
* Lead process and technology piloting, proof-of-concept builds, and equipment trials for new products, validating manufacturing feasibility and supporting Beta Build (P3), Production Readiness (P4), launch, and ramp to rate; hand off to sustainment engineering and the Value Stream/Area Manager for ownership after launch.
* Own the manufacturing readiness input to the P2 CapEx approval gate — defining the equipment, tooling, and automation investment required to support each new product launch, and building the business case with Finance.
* Represent Advanced Manufacturing Engineering at QRB/PRB stage-gate reviews, ensuring manufacturing technology risk is surfaced and mitigated early in the program.

Capital Equipment Life Cycle Planning

* Develop and maintain a multi-year capital equipment roadmap for forming and finishing across fabrication and assembly, aligned to the product roadmap, capacity plan, and overall plant strategy, in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing.
* Own the technical scope and justification for Capital Authorization Requests (CARs), partnering with Finance and plant leadership on prioritization, ROI, and total cost of ownership.
* Define an equipment standardization strategy to reduce total cost of ownership, spare-parts complexity, and technician training burden across the equipment fleet.
* Plan equipment replacement, upgrade, and end-of-life timing using Operational Availability (OA) trends, maintenance cost history, and technology obsolescence risk.
* Partner with Maintenance and Continuous Improvement on the Capital Equipment OA dashboards to identify chronically underperforming assets and translate the trend data into replacement, rebuild, or upgrade decisions.
* Direct capital project execution — technology selection, specification, supplier management, factory and site acceptance testing (FAT/SAT), installation, and equipment support for lasers, presses, and controls — through the Manager, Core Technology and the forming/finishing engineers, controls engineer, and capital equipment technicians.
* Manage the Manufacturing Engineering department budget, including advanced engineering and capital planning activities and tracking actual capital spend against the annual operating plan (AOP) capital budget; support post-installation return reviews on major capital projects.

Manufacturing System Design (MSD)

* Own factory flow design — layout, line balance, material flow, and cell design — and the standard design methodology used across the value streams, developed in collaboration with the Director of Continuous Improvement and the Director of Manufacturing.
* Assign MSD leadership to a designated senior forming/finishing engineer under the Manager, Core Technology, and review whether dedicated MSD headcount is warranted once the workload is visible.
* Drive adoption of MSD design standards and measure results in throughput and space and labor productivity.

Sustainment Engineering (Value Stream Support)

* Own sustainment engineering for the three value streams — process stability, yield, scrap, cost-down, problem solving, and repeat-issue closure —sustaining engineers, with a dotted-line relationship to each value stream leader.
* Set sustainment priorities with the Director of Manufacturing and the value stream leaders, and decide the allocation of engineering capacity between project work and reactive support so that project time is protected.

Advanced Manufacturing Technology & Automation

* Evaluate and recommend automation, robotics, and advanced fabrication/joining technology (e.g., laser welding, automated assembly cells) to advance Company’s manufacturing capability.
* Build technology pilots and investment business cases for automation projects, then partner with the responsible Value Stream/Area Manager on implementation and sustaining support once deployed.
* Benchmark Company’s manufacturing technology against industry best practice and maintain awareness of emerging capital equipment technology relevant to the company's product lines.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Governance

* Lead, coach, and develop the Manufacturing Engineering team providing project management leadership through those leaders and cross-functional project teams; build succession depth for each process.
* Own a single process model across the five processes and its handoff chain — NPD, then MSD, then core technology (installation), then sustainment after launch — with ECO supporting all four; publish decision rights and the handoff model with the VP of Manufacturing, the Director of Manufacturing, and the Director of Continuous Improvement.
* Partner with Product Development, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Finance on stage-gate reviews, launches, prioritization, and risk reviews, and represent manufacturing in design decisions (DFM/DFA) and cost targets.
* Support ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 requirements for new equipment qualification and process validation (PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans) on new capital assets and ECOs.
* Follow company manufacturing best practices — Standard Work, Visual Factory, and 5S — when deploying new processes, equipment, and engineering changes.

**Key Performance Measures:**

* ECO cycle time (submission to implementation) and engineering process standards compliance across value streams.
* On-time delivery of manufacturing readiness milestones at each NPD stage gate (P0–P3).
* Operational Availability (OA) trend for newly deployed and recently replaced capital assets.
* Capital plan adherence — actual spend vs. AOP capital budget, and realized ROI on major capital projects.
* Reduction in unplanned downtime and total cost of ownership across the managed equipment portfolio.
* Sustainment results across the value streams - first-pass yield, scrap, cost-down delivered, and repeat issue closure.
* Throughput and space and labor productivity gains from manufacturing system design projects.
* Team health - retention, succession coverage, and engagement.
* Number of automation/technology pilots successfully converted to full production deployment.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Industrial Engineering (or related field); 12+ years in manufacturing/process engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams with budget responsibility, and demonstrated leadership of capital equipment, automation, and engineering change management.
* Proven experience leading new product introduction from a manufacturing engineering perspective — DFM/DFA, process validation, PPAP — within a stage-gate NPD process.
* Direct experience owning an engineering change order (ECO) process and manufacturing engineering data/process standards (BOM, routing, work instructions).
* Strong background evaluating, specifying, and financially justifying capital equipment investment and managing a capital portfolio (business cases, ROI, total cost of ownership, Operational Availability).
* Familiarity with automation and robotics technology in fabrication or assembly environments; experience with laser cutting, forming, and welding automation a plus.
* Lean manufacturing / continuous improvement experience in a low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing system design, layout, line balance, cell design, and standard work.

new_roles.title: Director of Engineering and Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Reports to:**
Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

**Location:**
Export, Pennsylvania

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

www.kt-grant.com

**About the Role**

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on
**Director of Engineering and Manufacturing**
to lead the technical integrity, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement of our production facilities. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will bridge the gap between engineering innovation and shop-floor execution—overseeing complex manufacturing departments (including welding, machining, assembly, paint, and engineering) while driving job-level profitability, safety, and on-time delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operational & Multi-Site Production Leadership**

* Direct daily manufacturing operations across multiple departments (welding, machine shop, assembly, paint, and engineering) to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and customer commitments.
* Establish and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), lean workflows, and best practices to optimize cycle times, equipment utilization, and project coordination.
* Drive job-level profitability by monitoring labor productivity, managing working capital in staging/WIP areas, and executing rigorous cost-control measures.
* Partner with the Safety department to enforce strict regulatory compliance and foster an ethical, safety-first shop-floor culture.

**Engineering Strategy & Technical Execution**

* Define and execute the long-term engineering vision while leading day-to-day activities across mechanical, electrical, and process engineering disciplines.
* Provide technical oversight across the entire product lifecycle—from concept, equipment schematics, and Design for Manufacturability (DFM) through assembly and finished goods.
* Collaborate closely with Service and Maintenance teams to troubleshoot complex equipment (including hydraulic systems), manage preventative maintenance, and oversee rolling stock inventory.

**Financial Acumen & Strategic Growth**

* Partner with the CFO to formulate and manage annual Capital Expenditure (CapEx) and program budgets for manufacturing equipment and technology.
* Provide senior leadership with critical costing data and engineering value analyses to reduce Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and expand gross margins.
* Analyze industry trends and economic conditions to position our equipment design and production capabilities for long-term growth.

**Systems Integration & Supply Chain Collaboration**

* Lead the integration and optimization of ERP systems (such as SyteLine) and CAD tools (SolidWorks) into daily manufacturing workflows.
* Collaborate with Purchasing to forecast inventory needs, streamline purchase order flows, maintain material availability, and keep inventory days of supply low.

**Labor Relations & People Management**

* Partner with the Director of HR to manage workforce dynamics within a unionized environment, ensuring collective bargaining agreement compliance and resolving technical or scheduling disputes.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary engineering and production talent.
* Establish and track production KPIs and performance dashboards to drive accountability, timely shop output, and continuous team development.



**Qualifications & Experience:**

**Required:**

* **Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Electrical, Industrial, or Process Engineering (or a related engineering discipline).
* **Experience:**
 5–10+ years of progressive leadership experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams (mechanical, electrical, industrial/process) and complex manufacturing operations within the heavy industrial or heavy metals sector.
* **Labor Relations:**
 Direct experience managing a unionized workforce and navigating collective bargaining agreements.
* **Technical & Systems Proficiency:**
 Hands-on familiarity with ERP systems (SyteLine preferred), SolidWorks, KPI dashboards, Microsoft Office, and hydraulic equipment troubleshooting.
* **Financial & Regulatory Acumen:**
 Proven experience with CapEx budgeting, manufacturing cost accounting, COGS reduction, and regulatory compliance.
* **Leadership Traits:**
 Demonstrated ability to make rational, ethical decisions under pressure while balancing customer on-time delivery with shop-floor capacity.

**Preferred:**

* Master’s Degree in Engineering (MSE) or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or Six Sigma / Lean certification

new_roles.title: Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
The Director of Process Engineering & Continuous Improvement is the company's technical authority for how meals are made and the owner of its improvement engine. This hands-on leader combines deep manufacturing process engineering with a disciplined continuous improvement approach to make production operations more consistent, efficient, safe, and cost-effective across Mom's Meals.
 
 
The role will focus primarily on kitchen and production operations, supporting a highly automated manufacturing environment through process design, equipment performance, root cause problem solving, and structured improvement projects. The position will also support fulfillment operations by identifying automation and process opportunities that improve throughput, labor efficiency, accuracy, and customer service.
 
 
The Director partners closely with Production, Fulfillment, Supply Chain, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance, R&D, IT, and Finance to execute strategic projects and deliver measurable, sustained improvement across the enterprise. This is a player-coach role: the Director is expected to engage directly on the production floor, lead technical problem solving, and develop the engineers and improvement practitioners on the team.
 
 
**This position will travel to our other facilities 25-50% at varying times.**
**Ideally, the selected candidate will work out of one of our Production facilities (Ankeny/Grinnell, IA, Oklahoma City, OK, or North Jackson, OH) but are open to remote for the right skills and experience.**
**Benefits**
Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.
 
 
**Benefits Include**

* PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice
* 401(k) match
* Life insurance
* Short-term disability
* Health, dental and vision insurance
* Maternity/paternity leave
* Health savings account (HSA)
* Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

**Position Responsibilities May Include, But Not Limited To**
Process & Technical Engineering
 
 

* Serve as the company's process authority for meal production, owning process design, line layouts, standard work, and process specifications for cooking, chilling, portioning, and packaging
* Lead structured process control plans, risk assessments, and capability studies to reduce variation and improve consistency
* Drive yield, discard, and portion-control improvements through engineering-based solutions
* Partner with Production, Food Safety and Quality, Maintenance and R&D teams to ensure process changes are validated, documented, and sustained on the production floor
* Reduce downtime and defects through root cause analysis and hands-on, engineering-based problem solving
* Evaluate emerging manufacturing technologies and process innovations that improve efficiency, quality, and scalability
* Ensure engineering and process solutions comply with USDA, FDA, food safety, sanitary design, and regulatory requirements

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
 
 

* Build and lead a multi-site continuous improvement program, maintaining a prioritized project portfolio with defined savings targets validated with Finance
* Champion Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured problem-solving methodologies (such as A3, DMAIC, value stream mapping, changeover reduction, and standard work)
* Drive waste reduction, productivity improvement, and labor optimization initiatives
* Evaluate operational KPIs, including OEE, yield, labor productivity, and discards, and use data analytics to prioritize improvement opportunities
* Coach kitchen and production leaders and engineers in structured problem solving, and ensure improvements are standardized and sustained
* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement across operations

Kitchen & Production Engineering
 
 

* Lead engineering efforts supporting highly automated meal production operations
* Drive equipment performance, uptime, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvements
* Identify ideal equipment required to produce Mom's Meals to specification at scale, including equipment that should be replaced or decommissioned and equipment that can deliver OEE improvements and a measurable return on investment
* Partner with Production leadership and Commercialization team to identify bottlenecks and improve throughput
* Lead facility expansion projects, line installations, equipment upgrades, and process redesign initiatives

Capital & Automation Projects
 
 

* Develop and manage the engineering capital plan, prioritizing projects by safety, quality, and measurable return
* Lead project prioritization, design, budgeting, vendor selection, implementation, and startup activities
* Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget
* Manage external engineering firms, contractors, equipment suppliers, and system integrators
* Build a practical, multi-year automation roadmap focused on productivity, yield, and labor efficiency
* Establish project governance, reporting, and post-implementation performance reviews

Maintenance & Reliability Partnership
 
 

* Partner with Maintenance leadership on standards for asset management, equipment lifecycle planning, and preventative, predictive, and reliability-centered maintenance practices
* Use maintenance KPIs, including downtime, PM completion rates, equipment failure rates, and maintenance costs, to prioritize engineering and improvement work

Leadership & Team Development
 
 

* Provide coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership to process engineering, continuous improvement, and engineering personnel
* Develop future engineering leaders, improvement practitioners, and technical subject matter experts
* Promote a culture focused on safety, engagement, accountability, and operational excellence

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related technical field
* 10+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience within manufacturing, food production, and highly automated operations, including leading process engineering or continuous improvement teams
* Hands-on experience applying Lean and Six Sigma tools, with a demonstrated record of delivering quantified, sustained savings and performance gains
* Strong process engineering skills, including process design, root cause analysis, process capability, statistical analysis, and OEE and yield analytics
* Demonstrated success leading capital projects and automation implementations, including equipment installations and line upgrades
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, controls, packaging systems, and manufacturing technologies
* Knowledge of Sanitary Design Principles and Standards for food manufacturing.
* Experience leading teams in regulated manufacturing environments
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide change

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Food manufacturing, packaged goods, pharmaceutical, and automated distribution experience
* Experience with Industry 4.0 technologies, predictive maintenance, and digital manufacturing tools
* Experience managing and understanding facility utility controls, including HVAC, water, and steam systems
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or advanced technical degree

**Physical Requirements**

* Regularly required to use hands to feel, grab, or operate objects, tools, and controls while reaching with hands and arms
* Frequently required to stand, communicate, and listen
* Occasionally required to walk, stoop, kneel or crouch
* Occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds
* Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus
* Able to perform repetitive movements
* Able to work in variable temperatures (cold/hot)

**Company Overview**
Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.
 
 
**EEO**
Mom’s Meals complies with all applicable federal and state non-discrimination laws. Qualified applicants shall receive consideration for employment without regards to race, religion, national origin, ancestry, color, gender, age, disability, or veteran status.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering - Workplace Integration (General Assembly)
new_roles.description:
**About Rivian**
Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.
 
 
As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.
 
 
**Role Summary**
As a leader of a multi-disciplinary team of manufacturing engineers, you will be instrumental in launching new products and capacities at Rivian, transforming innovative ideas into tangible realities. This role sits at the intersection of product design, validation, factory design, and launch, ultimately delivering Rivian's best ideas into the hands of our customers. You will be responsible for leading and developing a motivated team of manufacturing SMEs in supporting all Rivian vehicle products and factories. This position is located at our Plymouth, MI headquarters or Georgia facility and will require significant travel to our manufacturing facilities in Normal, IL, and future locations. This role reports directly to the Director of Manufacturing Engineering in General Assembly.
 
 
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of manufacturing engineers responsible for designing and executing workstation design aligned with lean manufacturing principles. Workstation design supports overall plant metrics of 90 - 95% utilization and greater than 50 value added elements. Start to finish ownership of workstation design from virtual build through launch.
* Support Rivian manufacturing lines and sites and cover factory layout, manufacturing technology selection, equipment design, process design, etc.
* A special focus of this team will be advancing Rivian’s manufacturing technology and innovation roadmap
* Conduct virtual builds, support design validation builds of next generation products and provide Design for Manufacturing and Assembly feedback, collaborating with vehicle architecture, design, software, and other upstream partners
* Define and execute launch and ramp strategies, collaborating with launch, operations, RPS, quality and design responsible teams
* Deliver production documentation such as JES, PFMEA, Control Plans etc.
* Develop and implement processes, standards and workflows to improve team efficiency
* Actively mentor and grow manufacturing engineers and managers through technical leadership, translate vision into action, inspiring from ideation to execution
* Actively engage in value engineering, challenge assumptions and break the status quo

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or similar technical field.
* 10+ years of experience in an engineering role related to manufacturing engineering, DFMA, product optimization, manufacturing process or equipment development
* Expertise in manufacturing and industrial engineering principles (OEE, cycle time analysis, DVA, Cp/Cpk, GR&R, ergonomics, DOE, quality control, equipment selection, ROI, error proofing, supply chain & logistics)
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems using first principles, challenge assumptions and biased towards action
* Proven technical leader that can lead and influence cross-functional teams launching new products, lean manufacturing workstations and material flow processes
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, ability to concisely summarize and escalate complex topics
* Experienced working within 2D & 3D CAD environments, simulation tools and other digital tools in the field of engineering

**Pay Disclosure**
The salary range for this role is $161,000-$201,200 for Georgia and Michigan based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.
 
 
The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.
 
 
We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.
 
 
You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed any sooner than 1/1/2027.
 
 
**Interview Integrity & AI Policy**
Our interview process is designed to evaluate your personal technical foundation, real-time problem-solving logic, and structured capabilities. Therefore,
**the use of assistive generative AI tools to formulate or deliver your solutions during live interview sessions is not permitted**
. We care most about how you think — how you make sense of unclear requirements, weigh trade-offs, and explain why you chose one approach over another. We value your unique human perspective, your authenticity, and the journey it takes to reach a solution.
 
 
**Equal Opportunity**
Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.
 
 
Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.
 
 
**Candidate Data Privacy and Technology**
Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.
 
 
Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.
 
 
Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.
 
 
How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.
 
 
AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.
 
 
Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way.
 
 
**Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.**

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering & Operations
new_roles.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
 
 
**Position Summary**
The
**Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering & Operations**
is a highly visible leadership role within the Member & Client Services Engineering (MCSE) organization at CVS Health. This position is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, performance, and operational excellence of business-critical platforms that support millions of members, customer service operations, clinical services, and enterprise applications. In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, observability, incident management, and operational automation across a complex technology ecosystem. You will partner closely with engineering, infrastructure, architecture, and managed service providers to deliver highly reliable, scalable, and resilient technology solutions that support CVS Health's mission.
 
 
The ideal candidate is a strong technical leader with experience driving reliability engineering practices, operational excellence, and continuous improvement in large-scale enterprise environments. You will play a key role in advancing modern SRE capabilities, including AI-driven operations (AIOps), observability, automation, and proactive service reliability initiatives. As a people leader, you will build and develop high-performing teams, influence strategic technology decisions, and foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning. This role requires a passion for solving complex operational challenges, improving customer experiences, and driving measurable business outcomes through technology excellence.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Leadership
* Execute and advance the enterprise SRE strategy, including Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), error budgets, and reliability roadmaps.
* Establish reliability standards and best practices across applications, APIs, data platforms, and emerging AI-powered solutions.
* Champion a culture of reliability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
* Drive platform resiliency, scalability, performance, and risk mitigation initiatives.

**AI-Driven Operations (AIOps) & Automation**

* Lead the adoption of AIOps capabilities to improve proactive issue detection, predictive analytics, and operational efficiency.
* Implement AI-assisted incident management, automated remediation, self-healing capabilities, and standardized operational runbooks.
* Partner with AI and platform engineering teams to integrate machine learning and generative AI technologies into operational workflows.

**Observability & Monitoring**

* Define and lead the enterprise observability strategy across metrics, logs, traces, and user experience monitoring.
* Drive standardization and adoption of observability platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
* Deliver actionable insights, dashboards, and executive reporting related to platform health, availability, performance, and reliability metrics.

**Incident Management & Operational Excellence**

* Lead enterprise incident response, escalation management, and post-incident reviews.
* Reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Restore (MTTR), and recurring incidents through automation and preventive engineering practices.
* Establish operational readiness standards, on-call processes, and service management best practices.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, and long-term service stability initiatives.

**Leadership & Talent Development**

* Build, mentor, and lead high-performing global SRE and operations teams.
* Develop career growth frameworks, skill development programs, and technical leadership capabilities.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Partner with stakeholders across technology and business organizations to align reliability priorities with business objectives.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience required, one additional year of experience is required for each year of college not attained.
* 10+ or more years of production support or service delivery experience.
* Experience working with a managed services vendor.
* ITIL Qualified & Expert knowledge of ITIL disciplines.
* Experience of managing 3rd parties and 3rd party delivered services.
* Service Management or Support in a large-scale and diverse environment of incident management, escalation procedures and related disciplines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* High degree of self-motivation to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment.
* Strong communication skills are required to facilitate meetings with both technical and business audiences, often across multiple functional departments.
* Demonstrated understanding of various technologies (Java/J2EE, .Net, MQ, Mainframe, Telephony systems etc.)
* Experience with major database management systems, e.g. DB2, Oracle, and SQL Server.
* Experience creatively debugging complex system problems spanning entire hosting stack (application, server, communication channels, networking components, etc), resulting in problem determination and restoration through thorough research and fact finding.
* Be able to exhibit decisiveness and good judgment, even in ambiguous circumstances.
* Experience supporting both proprietary and vendor developed or supported applications.
* Demonstrated successful completion of technical projects.
* Demonstrated proficiency working on all phases of SDLC.
* Able to exhibit decisiveness and good judgment, even in ambiguous circumstances.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience required, one additional year of experience is required for each year of college not attained.
* ITIL certified

**Pay Range**
**The Typical Pay Range For This Role Is**
$106,605.00 - $213,210.00
 
 
This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors. This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.
 
 
Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.
 
 
**Great Benefits For Great People**
We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.
 
 
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.
 
 
Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.
 
 
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 11/30/2026
 
 
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager Manufacturing  Night Shift Operations Performance & Integration
new_roles.description:
Join Amgens Mission of Serving Patients
 
 
At Amgen, if you feel like youre part of something bigger, its because you are. Our shared missionto serve patients living with serious illnessesdrives all that we do.
 
 
Since 1980, weve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the worlds toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, youll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
 
 
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, youll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
 
 
Night Senior Manager Manufacturing Night Operations Performance & Integration (Continuous Improvement)
 
 
What you will do
 
 
Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role the Night Shift Senior Manager of Manufacturing at Amgen is responsible for establishing and sustaining a strong night-shift operating system that provides off-shift operational direction for Commercial Operations and for Project based Commissioning and Qualification (C&Q) coverage, ensuring the right cross-functional resources are engaged, issues are escalated and resolved with urgency, and manufacturing performance is actively managed across the shift.
 
 
Partners with Engineering, Automation, QA, Technology, Maintenance, Supply Chain/Warehouse, Capital Projects.
 
 
**Responsibilities**
Serve as the senior Manufacturing integration point across night-shift operations during significant operational events.
 
 
Establish and sustain the night-shift Tier structure, operating cadence, escalation model, and performance-management routines.
 
 
Coordinate Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Engineering, Automation, Maintenance, Supply Chain/Warehouse, and other site resources required to maintain safe, compliant, and reliable operations.
 
 
Drive escalation of significant resource constraints, technical barriers, competing priorities, or unresolved operational issues to appropriate site or functional leadership.
 
 
Monitor overall night-shift Manufacturing performance across production lines, including downtime, OEE, schedule attainment, recurring interruptions, escalation effectiveness, and chronic losses.
 
 
Partner with the daytime Manufacturing Senior Manager, Continuous Improvement Senior Manager and MFG process Support Senior Manager to identify, prioritize, and execute improvement opportunities across off-shift, including 5S, visual management, standard work, workplace organization, waste reduction, flow improvement, and training operating discipline.
 
 
Provide coaching and situational leadership to Front Line Managers during complex operational events
 
 
What we expect of you
 
 
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek will possess these qualifications.
 
 
**Basic Qualifications**
Doctorate degree and 2 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Masters degree and 6 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Bachelors degree and 8 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
Associates degree and 10 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
OR
 
 
High school diploma / GED and 12 years in GMP manufacturing, process development, or combination device, and/or manufacturing focused six sigma lean operational excellence.
 
 
In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have a minimum of 2 years experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above
 
 
What you can expect of us
 
 
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, well support your journey every step of the way.
 
 
In Addition To The Base Salary, Amgen Offers a Total Rewards Plan, Based On Eligibility, Comprising Of Health And Welfare Plans For Staff And Eligible Dependents, Financial Plans With Opportunities To Save Towards Retirement Or Other Goals, Work/life Balance, And Career Development Opportunities That May Include
 
 
A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental & vision coverage, and life & disability insurance
 
 
A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
 
 
Stock-based long-term incentives
 
 
Award-winning time-off plans
 
 
Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.
 
 
Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.
 
 
careers.amgen.com
 
 
In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.
 
 
Sponsorship
 
 
Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.
 
 
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.
 
 
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 
 
We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities, consistent with legal requirements. Please contact us to request accommodation.

new_roles.title: Sr. Manager Manufacturing Engineer
new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
 
 
**Environmental Conditions**
Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards
 
 
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
 
 
DESCRIPTION:
 
 
As a Sr. Manager, Manufacturing Engineering at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will guide and support engineering teams to drive operational excellence and innovation across our manufacturing facilities. You will provide strategic direction and technical leadership for manufacturing processes, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement projects while ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. Working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, you'll optimize production efficiency, implement new technologies, and deliver solutions that enable our mission of making the world healthier, cleaner and safer.
 
 
REQUIREMENTS:
 
 

* Advanced Degree plus 6 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 8 years of experience in regulated manufacturing environments (pharmaceutical, medical device, or related industries)
* Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Chemical) or related technical field. Strong focus on Automation required.
* Industry certifications in Six Sigma, PMP, or related areas are beneficial
* 5+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams and facilitating organizational change
* Demonstrated success implementing automation, digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives
* Strong understanding of cGMP, ISO standards and regulatory compliance requirements
* Experience with new product introductions, technology transfers and process validation
* Expertise in lean manufacturing principles, Six Sigma methodology and practical process improvements (PPI)
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic plans aligned with business objectives
* Strong project management skills and experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with data-driven decision making
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage stakeholders at all levels
* Proficiency with manufacturing systems, automation platforms and quality tools
* Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
* Experience with capital project planning, budgeting and resource allocation
* Relocation: Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer-sponsored work authorization.
* Pre-Employment Screening: Employment is contingent upon successful completion of all applicable pre-employment requirements, including a background check and drug screening, in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

**Compensation And Benefits**
The salary range estimated for this position based in New Jersey is $155,100.00–$232,650.00.
 
 
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:
 
 

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short- and long-term disability in accordance with company policy
* Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan
* Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount

For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total-rewards

new_roles.title: Sr Manager - Manufacturing Engineering
new_roles.description:
**About us:**
At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. Driven by a passion for excellence, we partner with leading Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences and Industrial companies to design, manufacture and service some of the world’s most transformative products, including advanced surgical systems, diagnostic instruments, healthcare imaging equipment, mission critical aerospace systems, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.
 
 
**When we invest in our people, we invest in building a better world.**
With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. It is our values that unite us and guide us in everything that we do, including how we operate, behave and interact to foster a workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.
 
 
Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.
 
 
As a team member, you will engage in impactful work through global collaboration and the use of emerging technologies, join an inclusive culture where every team member is valued and working toward a greater purpose, and be empowered to reach your full potential through various development programs designed to accelerate your growth.
 
 
Plexus offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members' wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, retirement savings, and opportunities for professional development. We also prioritize work-life balance and offer a variety of perks to enhance the team member experience. For more information, visit our US benefits website at usbenefits.plexus.com. Our commitment to pay range transparency fosters an equitable workplace, where everyone can feel valued. The annual compensation range for this position is stated below. The salary offered within this range will be based upon the geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level. Salary Range:
 
 
$132,500.00 - $198,700.00
 
 
**Purpose Statement:**
To provide leadership and direction to the Manufacturing Engineering team(s) from a functional perspective. Manage the Manufacturing Engineering function in line with functional specific strategies, process and systems development, people development, employee relations, plant level metrics.
 
 
**Key Job Accountabilities**

* Lead manufacturing-engineering excellence by collaborating with various functional leads to ensure engineering capability meets or exceeds manufacturing standards for quality product delivery.
* Support Program Management initiatives and activities to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Lead process/product/equipment engineering activities in compliance with Plexus Core Values to meet industry standards, regulatory and customer requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to site operations, establish a technology roadmap, and collaborate with corporate and regional technical teams to achieve lower costs and higher manufacturing returns.
* Responsible to exemplify and hold their team accountable to demonstrating the Plexus Core Values. Leader will focus on evaluating potential, driving succession planning, and ensuring their employees receive the development and coaching required to realize their full potential.

**Education/Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 8 or more years of related experience is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience will be considered.
* Proven leadership skills and management experience.

*This document does not represent a contract of employment and is not intended to capture every possible assignment the incumbent could be asked to perform.*
We are pleased to provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities or special requirements. If you need an application accommodation, please contact us by email at GHQ.TA@plexus.com. Please include your contact information and clearly describe how we can help you. This email is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
 
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
 
 
Some offers of employment are contingent upon successfully passing a drug screen and/or background check.

new_roles.title: Senior Staff Manufacturing Engineer
new_roles.description:
**Please Note:**
To conform with the United States Government Space Technology Export Regulations, the applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., conditional resident, asylee or refugee (protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
 
 
At
**CesiumAstro**
, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.
 
 
We are looking to add a
**Senior Staff Manufacturing Engineer**
to our team. In this role you will lead the development, implementation, and improvement of manufacturing processes, equipment, and production methods for products and platforms. This role contributes to manufacturing operations by establishing manufacturing approaches, resolving complex engineering challenges, and improving manufacturing capabilities that enhance product quality, manufacturability, and production efficiency.
 
 
Working cross-functionally with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and operations teams, the Senior Staff Manufacturing Engineer supports manufacturing engineering activities throughout the product lifecycle.
 
 
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Establish manufacturing processes, production workflows, tooling, fixtures, and work instructions supporting complex products and assemblies.
* Define manufacturing approaches by evaluating production requirements, process capability, equipment utilization, manufacturability, and production efficiency.
* Lead manufacturing process development through engineering analyses, design reviews, process evaluations, and technical assessments.
* Lead complex manufacturing process validation, equipment qualification, first article builds, and production readiness activities.
* Evaluate production performance, manufacturing data, process capability, and engineering risks while directing solutions that improve manufacturing performance.
* Validate manufacturing processes through qualification activities, root cause investigations, engineering changes, and corrective actions.
* Serve as the manufacturing engineering lead by coordinating manufacturing, quality, supply chain, production control, and operations teams supporting product development and production.
* Develop manufacturing documentation, work instructions, engineering reports, process flows, and manufacturing standards supporting engineering decisions.
* Support design reviews, manufacturing reviews, engineering investigations, and new product introduction activities by providing manufacturing engineering guidance.
* Establish manufacturing engineering best practices, process standards, production methods, and configuration management processes across programs.
* Evaluate manufacturing methodologies, production processes, and engineering practices to identify improvements.
* Drive initiatives that enhance manufacturability, quality, productivity, manufacturing efficiency, and production readiness.

**Job Requirements And Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, operations management, manufacturing technology, or a related field with 12–15 years of related experience, or Master's degree with 8–12 years of related experience, or PhD with 5–8 years of related experience in manufacturing, production operations, industrial engineering, machining, assembly, process improvement, or a related discipline.
* Technical experience in manufacturing engineering, production processes, engineering drawings, and manufacturing documentation.
* Advanced proficiency developing manufacturing processes, tooling, fixtures, production workflows, and manufacturing solutions for complex products.
* Comprehensive understanding of process validation, lean manufacturing, root cause analysis, quality systems, statistical process control, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience leading complex manufacturing engineering initiatives while balancing quality, manufacturability, productivity, cost, and schedule.
* Exercises sound judgment in establishing manufacturing approaches, resolving complex technical issues, and providing technical leadership.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Manufacturing engineering, CAD, and process analysis tools, e.g. SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Creo, or equivalent applications.
* Manufacturing execution systems (MES), ERP systems, engineering documentation, and collaboration tools, e.g. Epicor, SAP, Windchill, Jira, or equivalent applications.

CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Full-time employment offers include company stock options and a generous benefits package including health, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, life, disability and retirement plans.
 
 
CesiumAstro is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.
 
 
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
