new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

**About TTM**
-------------

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

**Scope:**

The Director of Quality reports to the GM with a strong dotted line to the Director of IE Quality. This position has full accountability for the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with AS9100 and customer /industry specific requirements. This role provides strategic and operational quality leadership across all aspects of the business from design to new product introduction and customer interface through to manufacturing, supply chain, and post-delivery support within a highly regulated aerospace and defense electronics manufacturing environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Own, maintain, and continually improve the AS9100D (IA9100)-compliant QMS across all business functions, ensuring customer and industry specific requirements are addressed. Ensure the QMS is maintained in accordance with all changes in standards and regulations.

* Maintain chemical processing compliance in accordance with NADCAP.

* Act as the central point for all audits, ensuring all audit findings are addressed with robust corrective actions and appropriate timescales.

* Co-ordinate resolution to customer issues across multiple functions, including applicable design, program management, process engineering and supply chain. Ensure appropriate communication of sensitive customer issues to senior leadership.

* Responsible for identifying and driving Quality KPI’s in accordance with business objectives.

* Lead continuous improvement activities and act as site champion for corporate continuous improvement initiatives, drive scrap, yield metrics and RMA metrics whilst developing a pipeline of core tool SME’s

* Drive Quality team strength using talent assessment to provide career development, focusing on core quality tools, industry requirements such as IPC/IA9100/IA9145/NACAP and data analytics.

* Drive supplier quality to reduce the impact of supply chain on manufacturing quality and lead times. Develop suppliers using an APQP approach to continually improve their process capability and compliance whilst reducing cost.

* As a member of the site senior management team, participate and engage with all functions to drive a people centric quality culture

* Maintain the necessary communications and effective relationships with other company functions required to support the operation.

* Supports business development proposals and engineering efforts by providing technical and production resources necessary.

* Key member of site Technical Review Board (TRB).

* Develops and maintains an effective operations organization through the selection, training, development, compensation and motivation of all personnel assigned to the operations organization. Recommends and approves organizational structures and staffing requirements in support of company business objectives.

* Complies with laws, company policy and procedures including but not limited to Equal Opportunity Employment, Affirmative Action, Business Ethics, EPA, OSHA and other federal, state and local regulatory agencies.

* Perform special assignments as needed.

**Education and Experience:**

* BS in engineering, science or related fields

* Minimum 10 years of experience in microelectronics / PCB manufacturing

* Minimum of 5 years senior leadership responsibility in a Quality Leadership function

* IPC certification and knowledge of relevant requirements

* AS9100/ISO9001/NADCAP experience with IATF TS16949 experience an advantage

* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt certified an advantage.

* Currently hold or ability to obtain a secret security clearance.

**Essential Knowledge and Skills:**

* Strong leadership and communication skills. Able to define goals and inspire the organization to achieve them. Provides clear, frequent direction to subordinates, and support functions, in support of quality goals.
* Able to maintain personal effectiveness and tolerate stress while handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment.
* Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to motivate team members to achieve optimal results. Leverages each member’s strengths and provides recognition of accomplishments to maximize overall results.
* High-performance team building. Uses appropriate methods and a flexible interpersonal style to help build a cohesive team. Ability to effectively manage conflict and create “win / win” outcomes for people and the business.
Proactively identifies execution risks and applies risk management tools and techniques to mitigate. 

**Export/ITAR Statement:**

Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC. b) Reinforce to all employees the commitment of TTM management to abide by all US Export laws and regulations. c) Understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL). d) Support Export Compliance Officers and others in their efforts to ensure compliance with the Corporate Export policies through implementation and enforcement of these procedures, provide training to all facilities and departments and support periodic audits as required. e) Provide feedback to Corporate Export Compliance Office for continuous improvement of procedures and overall Export Compliance program.

**Total Rewards Information**

*At TTM you will be joining a team that spans across nearly 20 facilities in North America that are bringing game-changing electronics to the market. As a teammate we are dedicated to providing opportunities that help you excel and reach your potential, so join us in our commitment to excellence and be part of the team that is Building the Future.*

*Listed below are some of the many benefits that TTM offers our teammates. Benefits are available on the first of the month following date of hire based on plan eligibility.*

**Wellness**

* Medical, Dental, Vision, including Telehealth support
* Company paid Life, AD&D, Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Option of Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contribution, or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Wellness Incentive Programs with company deposits into HSA Account
* Critical Care, Accident, and Hospital Indemnity options in addition to Legal Insurance and Pet Insurance
* PTO Program (15 days, annual accrual)
* 8 Company Holidays with an additional 2 floating holidays
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 

**Financial**

* 401(k) match program with immediate vesting
* Annual Bonus Program
* Referral Bonuses
Annual compensation review 

***Development***

* Professional development and training opportunities
* Cross training opportunities
* Tuition reimbursement for courses related to TTM’s business – up to $12,000 per year
* Annual performance reviews

***Compensation and Benefits:***
--------------------------------

TTM offers a variety of health and well-being benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401k, flexible spending and health savings accounts, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. Benefits are available on the 1st of the month following date of hire. For some positions, only PTO and holiday benefits are offered.

Compensation ranges for roles at TTM Technologies varies depending on a wide array of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At TTM Technologies, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on each individual set of circumstances. A reasonable estimate of the current range is:

$138,028 - $242,738

Additional compensation: An annual or quarterly company bonus may apply based on position assignment. Positions hired for alternative shift may be eligible for a shift premium based on the assigned shift and location.

***Export Statement:*** 
Must comply with TTM Export Control Policies and Procedures and all applicable laws including ITAR, EAR and OFAC including but not limited to: a) being able to identify ITAR product on the manufacturing floor and understand that access to these products and related technical data is restricted to only US Citizens and US Permanent Residents; b) recognition of Foreign Person visitors by badge differentiation; c) understand and follow authorization procedures for bringing foreign visitors into facilities (VAL); d) understand the Export and ITAR requirements for shipments leaving the US; e) manage vendor approvals for ITAR manufacturing and services.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship, disability or protected veteran status.

new_roles.title: Managing Director, Enterprise Quality
new_roles.description:
We are hiring a Managing Director, Enterprise Quality to join our Enterprise Risk Adjustment, Quality & Affordability team at BCBST!

In this role, reporting to the VP of Enterprise Risk Adjustment, Quality and Affordability, you will provide enterprise leadership and strategic direction for Quality ratings, with accountability for establishing and executing the enterprise Quality strategy and driving measurable performance across key programs and outcomes. You will lead and integrate quality efforts across Medicare, Commercial and Medicaid products, including MA Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, clinical quality, pharmacy, member experience, provider performance, data and analytics. You’ll establish clear governance and accountability, evaluate performance and the effectiveness of interventions, and partner across the organization to remove barriers, align priorities, and drive sustained improvement in enterprise Quality performance.

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring significant healthcare quality leadership experience and a track record of leading at the enterprise level. You’ll be a strong candidate if you have led complex Quality functions and are comfortable operating in a highly visible leadership role that requires influence across multiple areas of the organization.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Own and direct the enterprise Quality strategy, establishing priorities, objectives, and performance expectations across lines of business and key Quality domains, including Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, Appeals, clinical quality, member experience, provider performance, and other priority Quality areas.
* Establish and lead enterprise Quality governance and performance management, ensuring clear accountability among Quality leaders, Measure Champions, and cross-functional stakeholders for achievement of established goals and performance outcomes.
* Monitor enterprise Quality performance and intervention effectiveness, using data and analytics to identify emerging risks, performance gaps, and opportunities; ensure interventions are achieving required results and drive timely corrective action and escalation when performance is off track.
* Lead and integrate Quality efforts across the enterprise, partnering with Clinical Operations, Pharmacy, Provider and Network organizations, Customer Service, Member Experience and Outreach, Risk Adjustment, IT/Data, and other functions to align priorities, resolve cross-functional barriers, and coordinate Quality activities that extend beyond the formal Quality organization.
* Provide strategic oversight for clinical and service quality improvement, regulatory readiness, and accreditation, ensuring Quality programs and practices align with applicable CMS, NCQA, URAC, and other regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Direct enterprise strategies to improve provider Quality performance, including collaboration on provider engagement, value-based care, performance improvement, incentive programs, and other initiatives designed to improve clinical and Quality outcomes.
* Lead, develop, and align Quality leaders and teams, establishing clear expectations and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring the organization has the appropriate expertise, resources, and capabilities to achieve Quality objectives.
* Serve as a leader and advocate for Quality, communicating performance, risks, priorities, and recommendations to executive leadership and other key stakeholders and influencing decisions necessary to advance enterprise Quality outcomes.

**Job Qualifications**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, health sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, required. Equivalent experience is defined as four years of professional work experience in a corporate or healthcare environment.

Experience

* 10 years - Experience in healthcare, health insurance, Quality, performance improvement, or a related field required.
* 5 years - Progressive leadership experience, including responsibility for leading leaders and/or complex, cross-functional teams required.
* Significant experience leading healthcare Quality strategy, performance improvement, or Quality management programs required.
* Experience with healthcare Quality measurement and performance programs, including Medicare Advantage, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, or similar programs required.

Skills/Certifications

* Extensive knowledge of healthcare Quality measurement, performance improvement, and industry practices, including Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS/HOS, clinical quality, and provider performance.
* Strong knowledge of applicable healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements, including CMS, NCQA, and URAC.
* Strong strategic planning, analytical, and performance management skills with the ability to translate complex data and performance trends into actionable strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to establish accountability and drive results across complex, cross-functional environments, including areas outside of direct reporting authority.

**Number of Openings Available**

1

**Worker Type:**

Employee

**Company:**

BCBST BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee, Inc.

**Applying for this job indicates your acknowledgement and understanding of the following statements:**

BCBST will recruit, hire, train and promote individuals in all job classifications without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, citizenship, pregnancy, veteran status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Further information regarding BCBST's EEO Policies/Notices may be found by reviewing the following page:

BCBST's EEO Policies/Notices

**BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee via-email, the Internet or any other method without a valid, written Direct Placement Agreement in place for this position from BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee HR/Talent Acquisition will not be considered. No fee will be paid in the event the applicant is hired by BlueCross BlueShield of Tennessee as a result of the referral or through other means.**

new_roles.title: Director, Central Quality Audit, Pharmacovigilance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Managing, ensuring and improving capabilities to comply with external standards and regulations. Interprets internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Stays informed of industry trends that may influence work. 
 
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Own the Pharmacovigilance (PV) Audit Program: Develop, implement, and maintain the global PV audit strategy, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations (e.g., EMA, FDA, MHRA, PMDA) and industry best practices.
* Manage Audit Operations: Oversee scheduling, planning, execution, reporting, and follow-up for PV audits, including internal audits and audits of service providers and affiliates. Fully participate in the audit program; actively owning and executing PV audits.
* Risk Identification and Communication: Identify high-risk compliance issues, escalate findings, and provide actionable recommendations to senior leadership.
* Regulatory Inspection Support: Prepare for and support PV-related health authority inspections, including back-room management and post-inspection follow-up.
* Metrics and Reporting: Define and track PV audit KPIs, ensuring visibility of compliance risks and trends to leadership.
* System Ownership: Manage audit-related modules within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including support of configuration, UAT, and documentation.
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop a team of 3–5 auditors, providing coaching, mentorship, and performance management.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with PV Operations, Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure audit outcomes drive continuous improvement.
* Strategic Influence: Contribute to policy development and influence PV compliance strategy across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience, including team development and performance management.
* Qualified Lead Auditor with active certification.
* Master’s degree and 5+ years in pharmacovigilance or pharmaceutical industry; or Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years relevant experience.
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience driving Global programs to resolve quality compliance issues (directly).
* Experience with Pharmaceutical QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to cGMP, GDP, GPvP, GCP and GLP.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Experience with Medical Device QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to FDA CFR 21 820 and ISO 13485.
* Prior Veeva and TrackWise Digital experience a plus.
* Prior health authority experience a plus.
* IRCA, ASQ (CQE, CQA, etc.) and/or Lean Certification a plus (green belt, black belt).
* Extensive experience in the Medica Device and Pharmaceutical industry.
* Understanding of product quality improvement using tools such as Six Sigma, DFR.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
* Exceptional conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to interface with top organizational leadership and internal and external customers, responding in a professional manner.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to prioritize and drive multiple programs.
* Ability to energize others by building a connection with the team through personal involvement and trust, providing feedback and coaching to develop others, and accountability of actions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills in English.
* Integrity: Accepting and adhering to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, actions, and when dealing with others.
* Ability to travel globally up to 15%.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $142,400.00-$213,600.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

**Additional Information**
==========================

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

Application Deadline: December 21, 2026

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**About the Role:**

As Director of Quality, you’ll lead Helix’s quality department and drive the development of systems, practices, and people to ensure product excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction. You’ll hire, train, and manage the team, own the quality system, and make it clear who is responsible for quality at every step.

You’ll report directly to the Chief Executive Officer, partner closely with Engineering, Operations, and our customers to build a proactive, scalable, and right-sized quality system that enables growth.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership & Systems Development**

* Develop and continuously improve a scalable Quality Management System aligned with AS9100 and customer requirements
* Lead departmental strategy, structure, and capital planning to support business growth
* Serve as ISO/AS Management Representative

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and mentor a team of 5+ quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians
* Develop people and build team capabilities in metrology, inspection, and quality engineering
* Foster a culture of collaboration and real-time problem-solving on the shop floor

**Customer & Compliance Management**

* Lead customer and supplier audits; own response and resolution of corrective actions
* Ensure documentation, compliance, and audit readiness
* Build trusted relationships with key customers and act as the face of Quality

**Quality Engineering & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with operators to implement in-process quality at the machine (not just post-process inspection)
* Drive root cause analysis, SPC implementation, and corrective actions to reduce scrap and improve first-pass yield
* Support new product introductions and ensure proper gauges, fixtures, and inspection plans are in place

**Internal Inspection & Production Support**

* Oversee first-piece, in-process, and final inspection plans
* Continuously simplify and optimize inspection methods to reduce bottlenecks without sacrificing quality

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Promoting Operational Excellence by initiating and helping implement continuous improvement objectives.
* Maintaining a robust QMS system and compliance to AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards.
* Leading the company during customer audits and independent audits towards successful (re)certification.
* Lowering scrap and increasing first pass yield.
* Cross functional collaboration with Production and Engineering to help build quality into the process.
* Implementing solid Corrective Actions to reduce RMAs and DMRs.
* Establishing best practices for the Quality department and the organization as a whole

### **Who You Are**

* A pragmatic quality leader who blends systems thinking with real-world shop floor experience
* Confident navigating between big-picture strategy and hands-on process improvement
* A builder of systems and people, able to lead a team and train on complex equipment
* Comfortable in a customer-facing role and able to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Committed to continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivering value across departments

### **Qualifications:**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in manufacturing quality, preferably in machining-based environments
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards
* Experience leading customer and regulatory audits
* Proven people management skills
* Working knowledge of metrology, CMM, GD&T, and SPC tools
* Experience balancing compliance with operational efficiency

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Mechanical or technical degree
* Experience supporting New Product Development (NPD)
* Six Sigma, Lean, or ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA, CQM)
* Familiarity with vision systems, statistical software (e.g., Minitab), and automation of inspection processes

**About the Company:**

Helix Linear Technologies designs and manufactures high-precision motion control systems for industries where performance matters most, like aerospace, medical devices, and industrial automation. We’re in a phase of strategic growth, investing in R&D, advanced equipment, and new product lines, including aerospace-grade ball screws.

Our clean, climate-controlled facility is built for precision, focus, and continuous improvement. At Helix, you’ll join a team that values ownership, technical excellence, and curiosity.

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits, a retirement savings plan with company match, and paid time off and company holidays.

Helix Linear Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Due to U.S. export control laws, applicants must be U.S. persons (U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident).

new_roles.title: Senior Director - Customer Experience and Quality
new_roles.description:
Job Overview
 
The Sr. Director, Customer Experience & Quality owns the enterprise-wide direction and execution of Vontier Convenience Retails’ global strategy for customer experience, product quality, and reliability. The role serves as the senior advocate for the customer, this leader establishes global standards, governance, and priorities across global functions. Translating customer feedback, field performance, warranty data, and quality insights into priorities that improve products, services, processes, and support. This leader provides oversight and direction for improving the customer experience and connects Design for Reliability, Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Process Control, field quality, and Customer Service & Support into an integrated end-to-end customer experience. Working closely with commercial, product, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, service, and regional leaders, this position drives rapid issue resolution, systemic corrective action, and continuous improvement across the full product life cycle to increase customer satisfaction, loyalty, and business performance.
 
Responsibilities
 

* Own, create, and execute the enterprise-wide global customer experience and quality strategy, setting direction, priorities, and standards, and measurable objectives that advance business objectives, strengthens customer loyalty, and continuously improves customer outcomes.
* Establish and govern a disciplined enterprise voice-of-customer process that integrates customer feedback, complaints, service data, warranty trends, and field performance into product and operational priorities.
* Own and direct the global customer issue management and escalation process, ensuring rapid containment, transparent communication, root-cause resolution, and verification of corrective-action effectiveness.
* Build trusted relationships with strategic customers and customer quality teams; represent the business in quality reviews, escalations, and long-range improvement planning, with accountability for commitments and customer outcomes
* Implement and further develop the Vontier Reliability System to improve product reliability, serviceability, and customer experience across the installed base.
* Develop and lead a multi-year enterprise deployment plan aligned to the customer experience and quality strategy, including performance targets, resources, processes, governance, and organizational capability.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, Service, Procurement, and Manufacturing to embed customer requirements and quality controls from concept through end of life.
* Develop, govern, and continuously improve an integrated enterprise performance system covering customer satisfaction, complaint responsiveness, repeat issues, field reliability, warranty, external PPM, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Act as the customer experience and quality advisor to the Vontier Convenience Retail Executive team, using data and customer insights to influence priorities, investment decisions, and accountability.
* Build and lead a high-performing global team and foster a culture of customer focus, collaboration, problem solving, prevention, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to travel up to 30% of working time.

Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack
 
Essential
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in quality, engineering, operations, service, or customer facing role within a complex product or manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with accountability for quality performance, customer outcomes, and cross-functional improvement.
* Demonstrated success leading complex customer escalations, complaint resolution, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and executive-level customer communication.
* In-depth knowledge of quality management systems, product reliability, continuous improvement methods, and standards such as ISO 9001.
* Ability to translate voice-of-customer, field, warranty, and quality data into priorities, measurable action plans, and improved customer outcomes.
* Strong enterprise program change, and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to align global and cross-functional teams around complex business problems, and sustain accountability across functions and regions
* Executive-level communication, influencing, coaching, and relationship-building skills with customers, employees, suppliers, and senior leaders; willingness and ability to travel globally.

Preferable
 

* Advanced technical degree or an MBA is a plus.
* ASQ certification or equivalent (e.g., CMQ/OE, CQE)
* Extensive experience in lean manufacturing; including problem solving and use of kaizen
* Experience working with external partners (suppliers, customers, agencies) to accelerate progress and deliver results.
* Worked directly in or in supporting roles to software development, quality assurance, customer roll-out and software investigation and bug fix resolution.
* Customer facing experience working in roles such as customer service, order management, customer success, application engineering, key account management or sales.

Outcomes and Deliverables
 
Deliverables
 

* Global customer experience and quality strategy with a multi-year deployment plan, clear ownership, resources, governance, capability requirements, and measurable business targets.
* Enterprise voice-of-customer and customer issue management processes, including escalation governance, response standards, root-cause resolution, corrective-action verification, and closed-loop customer communication.
* Integrated customer experience and quality performance system, including dashboards and review routines for customer satisfaction, complaint response, repeat issues, reliability, warranty, external PPM, supplier quality, and cost of poor quality.

Outcomes
 

* A doubling of Net Promoter Scores for “Raving Fans” key customers over a 3 year strategic planning horizon

About Vontier
 
**Vontier (NYSE:** VNT) is a global industrial technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem. Leveraging leading market positions, decades of domain expertise and unparalleled portfolio breadth, Vontier powers the way the world moves – delivering smart, safe and sustainable solutions to our customers and the planet. Vontier has a culture of continuous improvement and innovation worldwide. Additional information about Vontier is available on the Company’s website at www.vontier.com.

new_roles.title: Director of Quality and Education
new_roles.description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the**Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award**, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

At Crème de la Crème, learning comes alive like nowhere else. Our centers are places that never stand still because kids never do. And when you join us, you’ll become part of that magic—making a memorable impact on young learners and their families every day. In our wow-worthy world of learning, your talents will be the catalyst for creating child care experiences you've never imagined. You’ll link arms with other exceptional humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do—and you’ll know that your work matters.

* As the Crème School Director of Education and Quality, you will 
 + Lead and develop teachers to ensure curriculum alignment with best practices, state standards, and the individual needs of children.
 + Facilitate training and implementation of our comprehensive and developmentally appropriate curriculum for early childhood education.
 + Provide transformative leadership in the field of early childhood education, staying informed about current trends, research, and best practices.
 + Develop a culture of continuous learning and professional development while leading the teaching staff.
 + Establish and maintain high-quality standards for early childhood education program
 + Conduct regular assessments, evaluations, and audits to ensure compliance with Crème standards and licensing requirements
 + Provide guidance and support to teaching staff, promoting a positive and collaborative work environment. In partnership with the Executive Director, host professional development programs to enhance educators' skills and knowledge.
 + Cultivate positive relationships with teachers and parents, involving them in their child's education and development.
 + Collaborate with the community to enhance the educational experience and promote your school within the community.
 + Assist as needed in daily school operations, at times including direct supervision of children
 + Apply data-driven insights to assess program effectiveness, implement strategies to address identified areas of improvement, fostering a culture of continuous quality enhancement.
* Qualifications:
* + Bachelor’s degree in early childhood education, Education Administration, or a related field. (preferred)
 + Meet state specific credentials / guidelines for the role
 + At least one year leadership experience in early childhood education or a related field
 + Proven understanding of early childhood development, educational best practices, and program administration.
 + Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
 + Outstanding customer service skills, strong organizational skills, and multi-task and handle multiple situations optimally.
 + Proven ability to build and sustain positive relationships with diverse staff, families, and community. Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in education.
 + Physically able to use a computer with basic proficiency, lift a minimum of 40pounds, and work indoors or outdoors.
 + Able to assume postures in low levels to allow physical and visual contact with children, see and hear well enough to keep children safe, and engage in physical activity.
 + Read, write, understand, and speak English to connect with children and their parents in English.

Range of pay $34,216.00 - $62,100.00 Salary

**Our benefits meet you where you are.** We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life: 

* Know your whole family is supported with **discounted child care** benefits.

* Breathe easy with **medical, dental, and vision** benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
* Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with **employee assistance programs.**
* Feel great and thrive with access to **health and wellness programs, paid time off** and **discounts** for work necessities, such as cell phones.
* … and much more.

 
.

We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

*KinderCare Learning Companies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.*

new_roles.company: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority
new_roles.title: SENIOR DIRECTOR, QUALITY MANAGEMENT (TRANSIT)
new_roles.description:
***Metro’s mission is to provide a world-class transportation system that enhances the quality of life for all who live, work, and play within LA County.***

**Description**
---------------

Directs and administers quality management programs in design, construction, and start-up operations of major Metro capital projects. The Director leads Metro’s quality management program for major transit capital projects, overseeing quality during design, construction, testing, and start-up of rail lines, stations, tunnels, and systems. They will also directs a team of agency and consultant quality professionals, oversees contractor quality control programs, and makes sure projects are delivered to standard and ready for safe operation.
 
 
Recruitment Timelines: Interviews are projected to be scheduled for the week of **December 14,** **2026****.** These dates are subject to change. We encourage you to monitor your governmentjobs.com profile and emails for the latest updates.

**Examples of Duties**
----------------------

* Schedules, plans, coordinates, and directs training, certification, team-building, and continuous improvement activities for all construction projects
* Establishes and monitors short- and long-range goals, budgets, schedules, and strategies for quality and continuous improvement programs
* Ensures quality requirements are included in all contracts for services, procurements, and construction
* Reviews and approves consultant/contract personnel/vendor quality programs and qualifications of responsible staff
* Identifies quality problems, then recommends and monitors solutions
* Analyzes and develops appropriate quality staff levels within engineering management and construction management contracts
* Directs the development and implementation of policies and procedures for quality and continuous improvement, including development, implementation, and maintenance of quality program manual; enforces quality program guidelines, standards, and procedures
* Reports to management on quality program performance measures and effectiveness
* Advises staff and management on quality concerns and solutions
* Participates in vendor contract negotiations for consultant and as-needed personnel; negotiates and manages consultant contracts
* Represents Metro with outside agencies and trade and professional organizations
* Authorizes stopping work or shipments that do not meet quality standards
* Supervises, trains, mentors, and motivates assigned staff
* Communicates and implements safety rules, policies, and procedures in support of the agency's safety vision and goals; and maintains accountability for the safety performance of all assigned employees

May be required to perform other related job duties

 

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

A combination of education and/or experience that provides the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the essential functions of the position. Additional experience, as outlined below, may be substituted for required education on a year-for-year basis. A typical combination includes:
 
 
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction, Architecture, or a related field; Master's Degree in a related field preferred

**Experience**

* Five years of relevant management-level experience in administering Total Quality Management programs for major capital projects

**Certifications/Licenses/Special Requirements**

* ASQ (American Society of Quality) Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence preferred
* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job-related essential functions
* Licensed Professional Engineer (PE) preferred

**Preferred Qualifications**

Preferred Qualifications (PQs) are used to identify relevant knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSAs) as determined by business necessity. These criteria are considered preferred qualifications and are not intended to serve as minimum requirements for the position. PQs will help support selection decisions throughout the recruitment. In addition, applicants who possess these PQs will not automatically be selected.

The following are the preferred qualifications:

* Experience managing quality assurance and quality control programs for the design and construction of rail transit, bored tunnels, underground stations.

* Experience overseeing quality during systems integration, testing, and start-up of rail transit systems, such as traction power, train control, and communications.

* Experience leading quality oversight of contractors on projects delivered through alternative methods, such as Design-Build (DB), Construction Manager/General Contractor (CM/GC), or Public-Private Partnership (P3).

* Experience developing and auditing quality management systems aligned with Federal Transit Administration (FTA) Quality Management System Guidelines or International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 9001.

**Essential Knowledge**
-----------------------

**Knowledge of** (defined as a learned body of information that is required for and applied in the performance of job tasks)

* Theories, principles, and practices of quality management and improvement and standards related to rail design, construction, and start-up operations
* Inspection and materials/systems testing principles and techniques
* Contract negotiation and administration
* Applicable local, state, and federal, laws, rules, and regulations governing requirements and standards of quality management for a public transportation agency
* Modern management theory

**Skill in** (defined as the proficient manual, verbal, or mental utilization of data, people, or things)

* Planning, organizing, and directing the work of quality management functions
* Establishing, implementing, and monitoring short- and long-range goals, budgets, schedules, and strategies for quality and continuous improvement programs
* Determining strategies to achieve goals
* Establishing and implementing relevant policies and procedures
* Analyzing situations, identifying problems, recommending solutions, and evaluating outcomes
* Exercising sound judgement and creativity in making decisions
* Communicating effectively orally and in writing
* Interacting professionally with elected officials, the Board of Directors, and outside representatives
* Mediation and negotiation

**Ability to** (defined as a present competence to perform an observable behavior or produce an observable result)

* Manage sensitive information
* Represent Metro before the public
* Understand, interpret, and apply laws, rules, regulations, policies, procedures, contracts, budgets, and labor/management agreements
* Make financial decisions within a budget
* Plan financial and staffing needs
* Supervise, train, mentor, and motivate assigned staff
* Travel to offsite locations
* Read, write, speak, and understand English

**Special Conditions**

new_roles.title: Director, Health Access & Quality Operations
new_roles.description:
The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is committed to expanding access to care, advancing health access, improving quality, and achieving better health outcomes for people living with diabetes, prediabetes, and obesity. The Director, Health Access & Quality Operations provides operational and financial oversight for the Health Access & Quality Department, ensuring effective planning, resource management, project execution, and performance accountability. Working closely with department leadership, Finance, Enterprise Strategy, the Program Management Office (PMO), and other internal stakeholders, this position translates departmental priorities into actionable plans, financial analyses, performance dashboards, and executive-level reporting.

 

The Director brings strong expertise in project and portfolio management, financial planning and analysis, dashboard development, and executive communications. The individual must demonstrate the ability to engage directly with Finance leaders on budgeting, forecasting, revenue and expense projections, financial variances, and resource allocation. Equally important is the ability to synthesize complex financial and operational information into meaningful insights, recommendations, and compelling presentations for executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

 

**Responsibilities** 
***Financial Planning & Analysis***

* Lead annual budget development and ongoing forecasting with Finance, including revenue and expense projections, reforecasts and scenario modeling.
* Prepare monthly budget-to-actual reports, analyze variances and recommend corrective actions.
* Track restricted and unrestricted funding, including grants, sponsorships and contracts, to ensure spending is compliant and aligned with funding requirements.
* Develop cost models, cost-benefit analyses and ROI assessments for new initiatives and investments.

 

***Project & Portfolio Management***

* Oversee the department's project portfolio, aligning priorities, resources, timelines and budgets with strategic goals.
* Develop project plans, timelines, risk logs and status reports, and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver on scope, schedule and budget.
* Partner with the PMO on governance, intake, prioritization and capacity planning.
* Monitor project budgets and burn rates, flagging risks early and proposing ways to reduce them.

 

***Performance Reporting & Executive Communications***

* Build and maintain executive dashboards and KPI scorecards that combine financial, operational and programmatic data.
* Prepare executive presentations, Board materials and management reports that explain complex information clearly.
* Present financial results, forecasts and project status to senior leadership to support decision-making.
* Show how financial investment connects to program outcomes and measurable impact.

 

***Operations & Process Improvement***

* Translate strategic priorities into operating plans with clear owners, timelines and success measures.
* Manage resource allocation, vendor contracts and spending controls in line with ADA policies.
* Identify inefficiencies and lead process improvements that produce measurable results.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to department leadership on financial, operational and project matters.

 

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Project Management, Operations, or a related field required.
* Formal finance education or training required, demonstrated through a degree, formal coursework, professional certification, or recognized financial management/financial planning and analysis training.
* Formal project management education or training required, demonstrated through a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) certification, or completion of a recognized project management training program.
* Equivalent combinations of education, professional training, and relevant experience may be considered, provided formal training in both finance and project management is demonstrated.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in business operations, financial planning and analysis, project or portfolio management, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex projects, developing project plans, coordinating cross-functional teams, and monitoring deliverables and outcomes.
* Substantial experience working directly with Finance leaders or Finance business partners on annual budgeting, revenue and expense forecasting, budget-to-actual analysis, variance reporting, and financial projections.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret financial statements, analyze financial performance, identify trends and variances, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Experience developing and maintaining executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, financial reports, and performance management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate financial, operational, and programmatic data to communicate organizational performance and measurable impact.
* Experience developing executive-level presentations, Board materials, and management reports that communicate complex information clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated experience engaging senior executives and presenting financial, operational, and performance information to leadership audiences.
* Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders within a complex, matrixed organization.
* Experience identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing process improvements that produce measurable results.

 

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Advanced project management certification or additional specialized training in portfolio management, program management, or business process improvement.
* Experience in nonprofit, healthcare, public health, or mission-driven organizations.
* Experience managing financial performance across multiple programs, funding sources, grants, or geographic markets.
* Familiarity with financial planning and analysis (FP&A), enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and business intelligence platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or comparable dashboard and project management platforms.
* Experience supporting executive leadership teams and preparing materials for Boards of Directors, Finance Committees, or other governance bodies.

 

**Why Work Here** 
The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) offers a rewarding career working for one of the premier voluntary health organizations in the world supporting people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Our employees consistently say that our mission, culture, work-life balance, and total rewards package are what they like most about working at the ADA. benefits and our culture:

* Industry competitive base pay. Base offers are determined by several factors including but not limited to your relevant work experience, education, certifications, location, internal pay equity, etc.
* A culture of recognition including new hire welcome announcements, service anniversary awards, referral bonuses, monthly All Employee Assembly, appreciation awards
* Generous Paid Time Off, including holidays, vacation days, personal days and sick days
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), disability & life insurance, pet insurance, and retirement savings
* Guided by our mission, we provide full diabetes supply coverage through our medical benefits program
* A company focus on offering mental health programs and work/life balance with most of our employees working remote
* Joining our dedicated team affords the gratification of knowing beyond a doubt that you will impact the lives and well-being of millions

 

**About the Organization** 
The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) is the nation’s leading voluntary health organization fighting to end diabetes and helping people living with diabetes thrive. Since 1940, we have driven discovery and research to prevent, manage, treat, and ultimately cure diabetes. We advocate for policy changes and improved access to quality care for all people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Through the Obesity Association, a division of the ADA, we are also working to reduce the prevalence of obesity—a leading risk factor for type 2 diabetes.

new_roles.description:
**Location:**

Rosedale Office Building

**Department:**

Patient/Medication Safety

**Shift:**

First Shift (United States of America)

**Standard Weekly Hours:**

40

**Summary:**

 

**SCHEDULE:** Monday-Friday, 8a-5p

 

***This role will work onsite at our Rosedale office building in Fort Worth, TX.***

 

The Director, Quality and Safety Capability Development leads the strategy, design, and delivery of organization-wide quality and safety learning programs. This role builds sustainable improvement capability across the health system by equipping leaders, physicians, clinicians, and staff with the knowledge, skills, and tools needed to improve outcomes, strengthen safety culture, reduce variation, and advance continuous improvement. The Director partners across clinical, operational, and administrative functions to support organizational performance and transformation.

 

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Lead the strategic direction for quality and safety capability development across the organization.
* Align education and development initiatives with organizational quality, safety, and performance priorities.
* Partner with executive and physician leaders to identify improvement opportunities and support risk reduction efforts.

**Program Development**

* Design and implement scalable quality and safety learning programs for leaders, clinicians, physicians, and staff.
* Develop curricula focused on continuous improvement, patient safety, leadership effectiveness, and data-informed decision-making.
* Utilize blended learning approaches to increase engagement and application of learning.

**Capability Building**

* Strengthen organizational capability in quality improvement and patient safety methodologies.
* Support leaders and teams in applying improvement science to clinical and operational challenges.
* Promote consistent improvement frameworks, tools, and practices across the health system.

**Leadership Engagement**

* Collaborate with clinical and physician leaders to develop and deliver impactful education.
* Build leader capability to drive quality and safety performance within their areas of responsibility.

**Integration & Measurement**

* Coordinate learning initiatives across departments to create an aligned approach to quality and safety development.
Partner with analytics and operational leaders to measure program effectiveness and organizational impact. 

 

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

 

**Experience**

10 years of pediatric healthcare experience including experience in clinical practice, healthcare education, workforce development, professional training, quality improvement, or patient safety. 



**Education**

Master's degree from an accredited college or university in Education, Adult Education, Instructional Design, Health Education, Organizational Development, or a related field. 

 

**Licensure, Registration, and/or Certification**

* Lean Certification or Six Sigma Green Belt required.
Certified Professional in Patient Safety (CPPS) or Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ) required. 

 

**About Us:**

 

Cook Children’s is an equal opportunity employer. As such, Cook Children’s offers equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected class in accordance with applicable federal laws. These opportunities include terms, conditions and privileges of employment, including but not limited to hiring, job placement, training, compensation, discipline, advancement and termination.

 

Cook Children’s is a Texas-only employer. If you are hired, you will need to maintain your primary residence within the state of Texas, along with all licenses and credentials required for your position throughout your employment.

**Head of Series Quality**
==========================

Job Req ID: 139101

Location:
Duncan, US, 29334

Work Type: Full time

Contract Type: unlimited

**Objective of job:**

* Accountable for the development and maintenance of plant quality operations processes, as well as the strategic oversight and management of direct reports.
 

**Principal activities:**

**Strategic Planning & Implementation:**

* Develops long-term strategy for Plant Series Quality department and ensures implementation. Coordinates budget and headcount planning based on strategic goals.

**Leadership & Expertise:**

* Provides technical and disciplinary leadership to Series Quality Operations associates. Acts as subject matter expert on Quality Systems and processes.

**Guidelines & Processes:**

* Implements and communicates guidelines, processes, and systems for Plant Series Quality department.

**Quality Training:**

* Develops and maintains Quality Training program, ensuring employees understand and utilize fundamental quality concepts, best practices, and tools.

**Quality Best Practices:**

* Customizes quality best practices/tools to fit Plant organization needs.

**Culture of Quality:**

* Promotes a culture of quality and continuous improvement through structured use of quality tools and problem-solving methodologies.

**QMS Administration:**

* Administers Plant QMS processes, ensuring product and process conformance. Monitors quality control processes and ensures proper execution.

**Audit Support:**

* Leads Quality Operations in preparation for audits, maintains certifications, and drives corrective/preventative actions for audit findings.

**KPI Tracking:**

* Develops, tracks, and reports relevant KPIs in cooperation with Plant and Corporate functions.

**Team Management:**

* Leads, coaches, supervises, and motivates direct reports. Manages day-to-day activities of Series Quality Operations team.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Identifies opportunities for process/product improvements and participates in corrective actions.
 

**Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor's Degree preferred.
* 6 to 8 years experience with a complex manufacturing facility.
* 3 to 5 years of Automotive experience (interiors preferred).
* 3 to 5 years of Leadership desired.
 

We are looking forward to your application.

new_roles.title: Director Global Quality
new_roles.description:
**About Momentive Technologies**

Momentive Technologies applies advanced materials science to design and manufacture ultra-high-performance quartz materials, quartz crucibles, and ceramic products that are vital to a variety of high-growth end markets, including the silicon and compound semiconductor industries, electronics, and aerospace components. These solutions enable the production of logic and memory chips, power control devices and multiple systems for electric vehicles, integrated circuits, power control devices, data servers, and aerospace applications.

Recognized for the purity, performance, consistency and stability of its products, Momentive Technologies has been delivering innovative solutions for over 130 years and continues to impact emerging trends like electrification, digitalization, renewable energy and artificial intelligence. The Company, headquartered in Strongsville, Ohio, has operations across the globe and serves customers in more than 30 countries. For more information, visit www.momentivetech.com

**Director Global Quality**

The Director, Global Quality is a highly visible leadership role responsible for shaping and advancing quality strategy across our global organization. Serving as a trusted advisor to the Executive Leadership Team, this individual will provide insight into quality performance, requirements, risks, and opportunities while driving greater consistency and excellence across operations in the United States, Germany, South Korea, China, and Japan.

This leader will champion continuous improvement, strengthen quality systems and processes, and identify opportunities to enhance both operational performance and customer satisfaction. Equally important, the Director will lead, mentor, and develop quality leaders across the regions, creating an engaged, accountable, and collaborative global Quality organization.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and lead the global Quality and QMS strategy, establishing standardized processes, governance, performance expectations, and accountability across global sites and product lines while ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, customer-specific, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Establish global quality standards and drive QMS harmonization, reducing unnecessary site-to-site variation and deploying common approaches for CAPA, nonconformance, change management, risk management, audits, document control, and management review.
* Lead global quality performance and continuous improvement, using quality trends, COPQ, yield, customer complaints, escapes, and systemic risk to prioritize improvement initiatives, allocate resources, and deliver sustainable improvement in quality and business performance.
* Own the global strategy for supplier and critical material quality, establishing standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, performance management, auditing, corrective action, and development to strengthen supplier capability and reduce risk to product quality and supply continuity.
* Provide leadership for significant customer, supplier, and product quality escalations, ensuring effective containment, root-cause investigation, corrective action, and systemic prevention while protecting customer relationships and business continuity.
* Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, Technology, and Commercial leadership to integrate quality requirements and risk management into sourcing decisions, manufacturing strategy, new products, process changes, and capacity expansion.
* Build global quality capability and organizational effectiveness, coaching Quality Leaders, facilitating deployment of best practices across sites and product lines, and strengthening technical competency, problem-solving discipline, training, talent development, and succession planning.
* Monitor emerging customer expectations, industry requirements, technologies, and external quality practices, translating relevant developments into the global quality strategy, QMS, supplier quality approach, and continuous improvement priorities.

**Basic Qualifications**

 

* A minimum of 10 years’ of experience in Quality Assurance or similar Quality role.
* 5+ years Leadership Experience directing a Professional Team, preferably on a global level.
* Strong proficiency in ISO 9001 and AS 9100 quality standards
* Outstanding organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage many projects or programs simultaneously.
* Possess a communication style that builds strong relationships at all levels of the organization and impacts outcomes and decisions.
* Demonstrated strong analytical expertise coupled with effective presentation, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
* Possess transformational leadership qualities – ability to engage, inspire, challenge and influence others and without formal authority.
* Experience in working with ERP systems, preferably SAP.
* Strong knowledge of problem solving and analytical tools such as 8-D, RCCA, SPC or similar
* Experience in industrial manufacturing, preferably chemical industry or glass industry

**Preferred Qualifications**

 

* Prior experience leading a global quality organization
* Expert knowledge of SAP QM functional module
* Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt Certification
* ISO9001 and AS9001 internal auditor or lead auditor certifications

**Travel Requirements:**

* 15-20%

**Total Rewards**

Our **Director Global Quality** will earn a variable compensation including base salary and bonus. Base salary range takes into consideration experience, education, and training. Not to mention all the amazing benefits available for employee selection as well.

**Joining the Momentive team includes:**

* Medical/Prescription Drug Coverage
* Dental Coverage
* Vision Coverage
* 401(k) plan with Company Match
* Basic and Voluntary Life/AD&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Wellness Program
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Referral Program

Momentive Technologies is not just shaping materials; we're shaping the future. As a leader in the fused quartz, ceramics, and crucibles industry, we pride ourselves on innovation, precision, and excellence. When you join us, you'll be part of a dynamic team that's driving advancements in technology, research, and applications across various sectors. **APPLY NOW!**

**EEO Statement**

We treat all our associates and candidates as equals. We require all associates and managers to do so too and comply with employment laws and regulations. All personnel actions are conducted in the spirit of equal employment. We are committed to recruit, train, promote and retain associates without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

**Accessibility Guidelines**

We are committed to making the on-line application experience easy and accessible to individuals with disabilities. We are constantly making improvements to comply with the spirit of the "Americans with Disabilities Act," and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines. If any of the information on the website is not accessible to you due to a disability, please contact us via phone at (440) 878-5739. Please provide the location of the inaccessible information and the format you wish to have the information presented and we will be happy to send it to you, either via your email address or a separate mailing address you provide. If you prefer, you may contact us and we will be happy to assist you with the application process.

**Location: St. Paul, MN | Columbia, MD | Charlotte, NC (Hybrid)**

In this position, you'll be based in one of the listed office locations for a minimum of three days a week, with the flexibility to work from home for some of your working week. Find out more about our flexible work culture at computershare.com/flex.

**We give you a world of potential**

Technology plays a critical role in helping Computershare deliver secure, resilient, and innovative solutions for clients around the world. Within our Corporate Trust technology organization, we're investing in the future of quality engineering and building a modern, engineering-led approach to quality that is deeply embedded within the software development lifecycle.

We're looking for a strategic and transformational Head of Quality Engineering to lead the evolution of quality engineering across Corporate Trust Technology. This role will define the quality engineering vision, operating model, standards, tooling, governance, and automation strategy while partnering closely with engineering, product, architecture, security, and business leaders.

This is an opportunity to shape the future of quality engineering across a global technology organization, lead large distributed teams, and drive the adoption of automation-first and AI-assisted testing practices at scale.

**A role you will love**

As the Head of Quality Engineering, you'll be responsible for establishing and executing the quality engineering strategy across Corporate Trust Technology. You'll help transform quality from a traditional quality assurance function into an engineering-led discipline focused on automation, continuous testing, risk reduction, and delivery excellence.

This role is ideal for a technology leader who enjoys influencing at scale, driving organizational change, building high-performing teams, and improving engineering outcomes across multiple delivery organizations.

**Other key responsibilities include:**

* Defining and executing the quality engineering vision, strategy, and operating model across Corporate Trust Technology.
* Leading quality engineering transformation initiatives and organizational change efforts.
* Driving automation-first testing strategies and Playwright adoption.
* Establishing enterprise quality standards, governance frameworks, policies, and reporting practices.
* Defining quality metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and continuous improvement processes.
* Leading and developing globally distributed quality engineering teams across onshore and offshore locations.
* Sponsoring adoption of AI-assisted testing, quality analytics, and intelligent automation capabilities.
* Providing executive oversight of quality outcomes, delivery risk, defect trends, and production incidents.
* Partnering with engineering, product, architecture, risk, compliance, and security teams to align quality practices with business objectives.
Building sustainable quality engineering capabilities through coaching, workforce planning, learning pathways, and succession planning. 

**What will you bring to the role?**

Required:

* Enterprise-scale quality engineering leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success leading quality engineering transformation initiatives.
* Strong automation expertise, particularly with Playwright.
* Experience establishing quality standards, governance frameworks, and engineering best practices.
* Experience supporting Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD delivery environments.
* Experience managing global and offshore technology teams.
* Strong understanding of test automation, quality engineering frameworks, software delivery lifecycle governance, and continuous testing practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing senior technology and business stakeholders. 

Preferred:

* QA-to-QE transformation experience.
* AI-assisted testing experience.
* Financial services technology experience.
* Experience leading Centers of Excellence or shared services organizations.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, Veracode, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise modernization or digital transformation programs.
Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments. 

**Rewards designed for you**

**Paid parental leave,** flexible working and a caring and inclusive culture.

**Health and wellbeing rewards** that can be tailored to support you and your family, including medical, dental and vision.

**Invest in your future** with 401k matching and tax-advantaged flexible spending plans, including healthcare, dependent care and commuter.

**Income protection** . Our package includes short and long-term disability benefits, life insurance and supplemental life insurance.

**Compensation:** The typical base pay range for this role is $124,568.00 - 155,000.00 for Columbia, MD and St Paul, MN. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.

**And more.** Ours is a welcoming and close-knit community, with experienced colleagues ready to help you grow. Our careers hub will help you find out more about our rewards and life at Computershare, visit computershare.com/careershub .

***This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.***

*Expected application deadline: 12/07/2026.*

*AI Statement*

*Computershare will use data analytics and artificial intelligence systems to help recruiters analyse and assess candidate and application information. These systems make our application and review process more efficient and assist our team in identifying candidates based on professional qualifications, skills and experience commensurate with the role applied for. All outputs from these systems are evaluated by our recruiters and are not the sole source of whether to consider a candidate for employment.*

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**SUMMARY**

Leads enterprise clinical quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and performance improvement initiatives to improve outcomes, drive operational excellence, and support strategic growth. Partners with clinical and operational leaders to establish quality standards, oversee governance and accreditation activities, implement data-driven improvement strategies, and advance innovative quality solutions that enhance organizational and client success.

**GENERAL HOURS OF WORK:** Monday through Friday (with occasional night and weekend involvement)

 

**REPORTS TO:** Chief Operating Officer

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

*Clinical Quality Leadership*

* Leads accreditation readiness, regulatory compliance, quality reporting, and corrective action planning activities.
* Leads the development and execution of enterprise-wide clinical quality, patient safety, and performance improvement strategies.
* Partners with physician and operational leaders to establish quality goals, drive accountability, and improve clinical outcomes.
* Coordinates and oversees quality improvement initiatives across all clinical programs and service lines.
* Monitors, analyzes, and reports quality performance metrics, benchmarks, and outcome trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Maintains quality policies, procedures, governance structures, and documentation standards.
* Supports clinical governance, risk management, peer review, and professional practice evaluation processes.
* Facilitates physician quality committees and multidisciplinary improvement teams.
* Promotes a culture of continuous improvement, evidence-based practice, and provider accountability for quality outcomes.

*Performance Improvement & Operational Excellence*

* Identifies workflow variation, standardization opportunities, and best practices to improve outcomes and operational performance.
* Implements and sustains process improvement efforts that reduce variation, improve reliability, and enhance patient experience.
* Partners with operational leaders to improve patient experience, clinical performance, and organizational effectiveness.

*Strategic Quality Engagement*

* Develops and executes Avel's enterprise quality and clinical transformation strategy.
* Designs and operationalizes scalable quality improvement services, frameworks, and methodologies for customers.
* Establishes quality and outcomes measurement as key components of Avel's value proposition and market differentiation.
* Serves as a trusted advisor to clients on quality strategy, patient safety, outcome improvement, and regulatory excellence.
* Identifies emerging healthcare quality trends and incorporate best practices and innovation into Avel solutions.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Health Care field required.

* Master's degree in healthcare or business administration preferred
* 10+ years of experience in medical staff office functions, quality, compliance, risk management and performance improvement required.

**ABOUT AVEL eCARE**

Avel eCare is a nationally recognized leader in virtual health, operating one of the most extensive virtual healthcare networks in the world. Based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, Avel partners with more than 650 health systems, rural hospitals, clinics, and facilities to deliver innovative telehealth solutions. Our services span Behavioral Health, Critical Care, Emergency, Hospitalist, Pharmacy, Specialty Clinic, Senior Care, and School Health — impacting nearly two million patients annually.

For three decades, Avel has been at the forefront of healthcare innovation, developing telehealth solutions that reduce costs, save time, and remove barriers to quality care. Join our mission-driven team and help reshape the future of healthcare.

**MISSION**

"We transform access to high-quality healthcare for people and communities through integrated virtual solutions."

**VISION**

"Setting the standard for healthcare delivery by creating the nation’s most trusted Virtual Health System, through innovation and partnership."
