new_roles.title: Director of Program Quality
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary**

CLA seeks an experienced leader to oversee CLA’s Quality Program. Supervise the Quality Assurance Professional, Certified Professional Trainers, Community Case Management Program Manager, RN Association Nurse/CCM Clinical Supervisor, and Shared Living Coordinator, providing supports for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities. The person in this role will review Quality Improvement Systems, monitor and direct audits of service quality and compliance, and act as the steward of policies, conventions, and forms used in Active Treatment. This person will supervise quality and content of training; organize and schedule training, and market training outside of CLA. Research, review, and support compliance with applicable state and federal licensing and program rules, laws, and regulations. As a member of the senior leadership team, the Director of Program Quality will work collaboratively with the Executive Director and peers for the best interest of the entire organization and mission.

​Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Social or Human Services, Special Education, or related field and 4 years’ experience working with individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Progressively more responsible administrative, fiscal, supervisory, and management experience. Proven success in assisted living, health care, or social service setting. Excellent written, interpersonal, verbal communication, and computer skills; ability to prioritize, organize, and manage multiple tasks effectively.

**Skills**

* Healthcare or IDD quality assurance experience, team leadership, and project management experience in healthcare; demonstrated process improvement and compliance management capabilities.

Pay: $75,000.00 - $90,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Referral program
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Division Quality Director - Commercial Aerospace
new_roles.description:
**Position Summary**

At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers.

The Commercial Flight Controls Division, headquartered in beautiful Ogden, Utah, is a global leader in aerospace flight controls.

We are the preferred supplier of flight control solutions for the commercial, regional, business jet and advanced air mobility marketplace by offering a premier customer experience with superior engineered products that exceed our customer and regulatory requirements.

Come join the Parker Aerospace Team!

***This position is subject to meeting U.S. Export Compliance and/or U.S. Government Contracting Citizenship eligibility requirements.***

***This is an on-site Sr. Director role located in our Commercial Flight Controls Division located in Ogden, UT.***

***Bachelor's Degree in an Engineering or related technical/scientific discipline required.******An M.B.A., or an advanced technical degree is strongly preferred.***

***10+ years leading a large quality department within the aerospace or automotive manufacturing industry required.***

***Must have a passion for leading others and developing talent.***

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Director of Quality provides leadership, strategic direction, and governance for product quality and regulatory compliance across the division’s OEM Manufacturing and Part 145 MRO business. Operating as a true leader of leaders, this role drives a unified quality and safety culture and holds ultimate responsibility for the Quality Management System (QMS).

The Director executes the quality strategy by leading a comprehensive team of specialized quality managers responsible for Supplier Quality, Customer Quality, Production Quality (OEM), Repair Station Quality as well as inspection and NDT. This position serves as the primary leadership focal point to large commercial aerospace customers, critical suppliers, regulatory agencies, and group/corporate leadership.

**SCOPE/SUPERVISION AND INTERACTION:**

Reports directly to the Division General Manager and is a member of the division leadership team, with a strong dotted line to the VP of Quality.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Communicates customer, regulatory and organizational requirements to assure product quality, contract compliance and customer satisfaction.
* Oversees the effective documentation and implementation of the quality management system to assure compliance with customer and regulatory requirements and the standards set by corporate/division policies.
* Works with Division leadership to ensure that individuals performing functions affecting quality are trained and demonstrate the appropriate skills and performance results.
* Coordinates necessary team member resources for internal, customer and third-party quality system audits.
* Maintains a corrective action system to analyze and correct nonconforming conditions and complaints.
* Implements the performance measurements necessary to effectively evaluate organizational performance and trends in product quality, services, customer satisfaction and the cost of poor quality. Uses the results of performance evaluation to target improvement efforts.
* Collaborates with the supply chain function on the development and implementation of a supplier management strategy.
* Assess supplier capabilities and monitor supplier quality to ensure desired levels of performance.
* Collaborates with Engineering on new product development and design review for quality/reliability issues.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's Degree in an Engineering or related technical/scientific discipline. An M.B.A., or an advanced technical degree is strongly preferred.
* 10+ years leading a large quality department within the aerospace or automotive manufacturing industry.
* Thorough knowledge of Standard AS9100 Quality Management Systems.
* Certification by the American Society for Quality (ASQ) as a Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Six Sigma Black Belt (CSSBB), or Certified Quality Manager (CQMgr) is preferred.
* Deep knowledge of manufacturing and quality technologies.
* Experience with quality improvement tools and techniques (i.e., Lean, Six Sigma, Statistical Process Control, and Failure Mode & Effects Analysis).
* Demonstrated leadership, project management, facilitation and problem-solving skills.
* Must demonstrate effective verbal and written communication skills and have demonstrated experience presenting to executive level leadership

**We offer a comprehensive and competitive total compensation package.**

**Come join the Parker Aerospace Team! We are proud to offer competitive benefits designed with health, wealth and well-being in mind.**

**Benefit & Retirement Plans**

**Parker offers competitive benefit programs, including:**

* Comprehensive coverage for medical, prescription drugs, dental, vision, voluntary optional life, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance and critical illness insurance with competitive premium cost.
* 401(k) Plan with company matching contributions at 100% of the first 5% of pay
* Company provided defined-contribution retirement plan with annual contribution equal to 3% of pay
* Career development and tuition reimbursement
* Other benefits including paid parental leave, short and long-term disability programs, adoption assistance, a Care.com membership and financial planning assistance are provided at no cost to you.
* Supplemental benefit programs including identity protection, legal protection, and pet wellness are available at competitive rates.
* Paid Time Off and 13 Company-Paid Holidays.

**Drug-Free Workplace** 
In accordance with Parker’s policies and applicable state laws, Parker provides for a drug-free workplace. Therefore, all applicants seeking employment with Parker will be subject to drug testing as a condition of employment.

**This position is subject to meeting U.S. export compliance and/or U.S Government contracting citizenship eligibility requirements****.**

 

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

**Additional Comments:**

The essential functions have been provided as example of the type of work performed by employees assigned to this job classification. The company reserves the right to modify the work assignments and/or to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions. new_roles.title: VP, Operations
new_roles.description:
**Building the people that build the world.**

With platforms in HVAC and Detection and Measurement, SPX Technologies builds innovative solutions that enable a safer, more efficient, sustainable world. Through our RiSE talent development framework, we Reach, Identify, Strengthen, and Engage our employees to support them in their continued development. We’re a global company of problem solvers, collaborators, and innovators, and our businesses build solutions that impact the world.

As part of HVAC Cooling, SPX Cooling Technologies is a leader in high quality industrial HVAC equipment used to cool large facilities like hospitals, data centers, and power plants. With cooling towers, fans, and refrigeration units, companies rely on brands like Marley, Recold, and SGS to provide comfort and mission critical and industrial cooling solutions.

 

**How You Will Make an Impact**

The Vice President, Operations is a key member of the business unit leadership team and is responsible for the global operations strategy and execution for a rapidly growing business scaling beyond $1.5 billion in annual revenue. This leader will have responsibility for a global manufacturing network of 8+ facilities and will ensure the operations organization has the capacity, capabilities, systems, talent, and processes required to support significant organic and inorganic growth.

The VP, Operations will establish and execute a scalable global operating model that delivers world-class performance across safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, working capital, and customer service. This leader will drive greater consistency and integration across manufacturing locations while ensuring the operating footprint, capital investments, supply chain capabilities, and organizational structure are positioned to support long-term growth.

A critical priority will be building an operations organization capable of operating at significantly greater scale. The VP will develop strong plant and functional leaders, create clear accountability across the operations network, institutionalize continuous improvement, and partner closely with Commercial, Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Human Resources, and Supply Chain to translate business strategy into operational execution.

**What You Can Expect in This Role**

* **Develop and execute the global operations strategy** to support the business unit's growth, financial objectives, customer commitments, and long-term strategic plan.
* **Lead the global manufacturing network of 8+ facilities**, establishing common operating expectations, performance metrics, management systems, and accountability across locations.
* **Build the operational capacity and capabilities required to support a $2B+ business**, anticipating future requirements for facilities, equipment, automation, technology, supply chain, and talent.
* **Own manufacturing footprint and capacity strategy**, including plant utilization, expansions, greenfield/start-up operations, consolidations, transfers of production, and other network optimization opportunities.
* **Drive world-class performance across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Working Capital**, establishing clear performance expectations and corrective actions across the global operating organization.
* **Champion a culture of safety**, ensuring consistent leadership practices, risk identification, corrective actions, compliance, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing locations.
* **Establish a disciplined Lean operating system** utilizing standard work, daily management, Kaizen, problem solving, value-stream optimization, and other continuous improvement methodologies to drive sustained performance improvement.
* **Improve operational scalability and productivity** through automation, manufacturing technology, process redesign, labor productivity, plant layout optimization, and improved utilization of assets.
* **Lead operations planning and execution**, ensuring alignment between customer demand, production capacity, labor, materials, inventory, and capital requirements through disciplined SIOP/S&OP and scheduling processes.
* **Optimize material flow and working capital**, improving inventory turns, supplier performance, schedule adherence, throughput, and overall cash conversion.
* **Develop and execute the global capital strategy for Operations**, prioritizing investments based on growth requirements, productivity, safety, quality, capacity, automation, and return on invested capital.
* **Partner with Engineering and Commercial leadership** to improve manufacturability, new product introduction, quote-to-delivery execution, capacity planning, and responsiveness to changing customer requirements.
* **Support acquisition integration and business expansion**, establishing operating standards, identifying synergies, integrating newly acquired manufacturing operations, and accelerating performance improvement.
* **Build a high-performing global Operations leadership team**, strengthening succession depth and developing Plant Managers and functional leaders capable of leading increasingly large and complex operations.
* **Create a culture of accountability and operational excellence**, ensuring leaders use data, metrics, structured problem solving, and operating rhythms to identify issues early and deliver commitments.
* **Serve as a strategic advisor to the President and business leadership team**, bringing an operations perspective to growth strategy, investment decisions, customer commitments, acquisitions, organizational design, and long-range planning.

**Key Measures of Success**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

* Sustained improvement in employee safety and environmental performance
* World-class product quality and reduction in customer quality issues
* 95%+ on-time delivery performance and improved schedule adherence
* Year-over-year productivity and manufacturing cost improvement
* Improved inventory turns and working capital performance
* Effective deployment and return on capital investments
* Capacity and manufacturing footprint aligned with business growth
* Successful operational integration of acquisitions and new facilities
* Strong succession depth and leadership capability across Operations
* Consistent implementation of operating systems and best practices across the global manufacturing network

**What We Are Looking For**

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive operations and manufacturing leadership experience, including significant leadership of complex, multi-site operations.
* Demonstrated experience leading a large-scale global or geographically dispersed manufacturing organization.
* Experience operating within a business of significant scale and complexity, ideally $1B+ in revenue with demonstrated experience supporting substantial growth.
* Proven ability to scale manufacturing capacity, systems, processes, and organizations during periods of rapid growth.
* Demonstrated success improving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, cost, and working capital performance across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Strong experience in Lean manufacturing and building sustainable continuous improvement cultures.
* Experience developing manufacturing footprint strategies including plant expansions, start-ups, consolidations, transfers, and capacity investments.
* Demonstrated success developing senior operations leaders and building strong succession pipelines.
* Experience working effectively within a matrixed, global organization and influencing across functions.
* Experience operating in both union and non-union manufacturing environments preferred.
* Experience integrating acquired businesses or manufacturing operations strongly preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Enterprise-level strategic thinking combined with a strong bias for execution.
* Ability to translate aggressive business growth plans into executable operations, capacity, talent, and capital strategies.
* Strong financial and business acumen with an understanding of operating margin, manufacturing economics, capital allocation, working capital, and return on investment.
* Demonstrated ability to establish operating systems, metrics, governance, and accountability across a diverse manufacturing network.
* Strong change leadership capability and demonstrated success leading organizations through significant growth and transformation.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to operate effectively from the plant floor through the executive leadership team.
* Ability to identify emerging operational risks, resolve near-term issues, and simultaneously build the capabilities required for long-term growth.
* Strong knowledge of ERP, planning, manufacturing technology, automation, and data-driven operating environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, Supply Chain, or related field required.
* MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred.
* Lean/Six Sigma or comparable continuous improvement certification preferred.

**Travel & Working Environment**

* Significant domestic and international travel required to maintain strong leadership presence across the global manufacturing network.
* Regular interaction within manufacturing environments with varying levels of noise, temperature, and other plant conditions.

**How we live our culture**

Our culture is at the center of what we do and, more importantly, who we are. Our core values set a standard for how we manage ourselves, and our Leadership Model sets the standard for how we engage with each other. Whether you are an individual contributor or you lead a large team, each of us leads at SPX.

**What benefits do we offer?**

We know that the well-being of our employees is integral. Our benefits include:

* Generous and flexible paid time off including paid personal time off, caregiver, parental, and volunteer leave
* Competitive health insurance plans and 401(k) match, with benefits starting day one
* Competitive and performance-based compensation packages and bonus plans
* Educational assistance, leadership development programs, and recognition programs

**Our commitment to embrace diversity to build a culture of inclusion at SPX**

We value different backgrounds, experiences, and voices at SPX, and we are committed to challenging ourselves, openly communicating, and striving to improve every day. We believe in creating an inclusive work environment where everyone has a voice and is encouraged to realize their fullest potential.

SPX is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer committed to making selection decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation or identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.

new_roles.title: Vice President of Operations
new_roles.description:
**About the Role:**

The Vice President of Operations in a manufacturing environment is responsible for overseeing and optimizing all operational aspects to ensure efficiency, quality, and profitability. This role requires strategic leadership to align operational goals with the company’s overall vision and market demands. The VP of Operations will drive continuous improvement initiatives, manage cross-functional teams, and implement best practices to enhance production processes and supply chain management. They will also play a critical role in financial planning, resource allocation, and risk management to support sustainable growth. Ultimately, this position ensures that manufacturing operations meet customer expectations while maintaining compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing operations.
* Proven track record of strategic planning and successful execution in a complex manufacturing environment.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large teams and manage cross-functional projects.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or relevant advanced degree.
* Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Familiarity with advanced data analytics tools and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems.
* Previous experience in a senior executive role within the manufacturing industry.
* Certifications related to operations management or leadership development.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive operational strategies that support the company’s business objectives and growth plans.
* Lead and mentor senior management and operational teams to foster a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee production planning, quality control, supply chain logistics, and maintenance to maximize operational efficiency and product quality.
* Collaborate with finance to manage budgets, forecast operational costs, and analyze financial performance to inform decision-making.
* Utilize data analytics to monitor key performance indicators, identify operational risks, and implement corrective actions promptly.
* Drive talent development initiatives to build a skilled and motivated workforce aligned with organizational goals.
* Communicate operational plans, progress, and challenges effectively to the executive leadership team and stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental regulations, and industry standards across all manufacturing sites.

**Skills:**

The required skills such as Executive Presence and Leadership are essential for inspiring and guiding diverse teams while representing the operations function at the executive level. Strategic Planning and Execution skills enable the VP to develop actionable roadmaps that align operational activities with long-term business goals. Operational Strategy expertise is applied daily to optimize manufacturing processes, improve supply chain efficiency, and ensure product quality. Communication and Presentation skills are critical for articulating complex operational plans and performance metrics to stakeholders clearly and persuasively. Delegation, Financial Planning and Analysis, Data Analysis, and Talent Development skills are utilized to empower teams, manage resources effectively, make data-driven decisions, and cultivate a high-performing workforce that drives continuous operational excellence.

new_roles.title: VP of Ops for a fast growing Food Production Facility
new_roles.description:
Taher is seeking a **Vice President of Operations** to lead its Production Kitchen in Plymouth, Minnesota. This senior leadership role is responsible for the day-to-day and long-term operational performance of a high-volume food production environment, including production, packaging, food safety, quality assurance, sanitation, maintenance, production planning, staffing, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, people-centered operations leader who can strengthen systems, support employee development, improve production efficiency, and protect Taher's commitment to safe, high-quality, chef-driven food. This individual will bring operational discipline, food production expertise, financial acumen, and the ability to lead teams through growth while maintaining a strong culture of safety, quality, teamwork, and accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Strategic** **and Operational** **Leadership**
------------------------------------------------

* Develop and execute the operations strategy for the Plymouth Production Kitchen in alignment with Taher's business goals, customer commitments, and growth opportunities.
* Partner with senior leadership, culinary, purchasing, finance, human resources, quality assurance, and customer-facing teams to support production growth and operational excellence.
* Lead planning for new products, increased production volumes, new lines, equipment needs, and staffing models.
* Establish clear operational goals, performance standards, and daily accountability routines for safety, quality, service, cost, and people.

**Production Kitchen** **Operations**
-------------------------------------

* Provide leadership and oversight for daily production, packaging, storage, sanitation, and outbound readiness at the Plymouth Production Kitchen.
* Drive improvements in employee safety, food safety, quality, throughput, labor utilization, line balance, yield, waste, and on-time completion.
* Ensure production schedules are met while maintaining product specifications, ingredient standards, labeling accuracy, and customer requirements.
* Optimize staffing models across shifts, production lines, machine operations, hand-wrapping, packing, rework, and support functions.
* Support supervisors, leads, maintenance, quality, and production teams in identifying and resolving issues quickly and professionally.

**Food Safety****,** **Quality****, and Compliance**
----------------------------------------------------

* Ensure a strong culture of food safety, sanitation, quality, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across all production activities.
* Oversee compliance with applicable FDA, USDA, OSHA, HACCP, GMP, allergen control, labeling, sanitation, and customer requirements.
* Partner with Food Safety and Quality Assurance leadership to maintain strong systems for product checks, inspections, corrective actions, documentation, and audit readiness.
* Ensure timely investigation and resolution of product quality, food safety, foreign material, temperature, sanitation, and customer concerns.

**Supply Chain****,** **Planning****, and Material Readiness**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with purchasing, inventory, warehouse, culinary, and production planning teams to ensure ingredients, packaging, labels, equipment, and labor are ready before production begins.
* Improve production scheduling, inventory accuracy, freezer/cooler organization, material flow, and customer service performance.
* Identify opportunities to reduce complexity, prevent shortages, improve changeovers, and strengthen end-to-end execution from receiving through shipping.

**Financial and Operational Performance**
-----------------------------------------

* Own operational budgets for the Plymouth Production Kitchen and contribute to annual operating, staffing, equipment, and capital plans.
* Drive cost control and margin improvement without compromising food safety, product quality, employee safety, or customer expectations.
* Monitor key performance indicators including labor efficiency, yield, waste, downtime, rework, production output, inventory accuracy, and service levels.
* Identify and execute opportunities to improve profitability, line productivity, equipment utilization, and return on invested capital.

**Continuous Improvement****, Equipment,** **and** **Facility Support**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* Champion practical continuous improvement methods that help teams work safer, faster, cleaner, and more consistently.
* Develop and execute programs to reduce downtime, improve line flow, minimize waste, strengthen changeovers, and increase production capacity.
* Oversee equipment investments, automation opportunities, maintenance priorities, facility improvements, and capital projects.
* Promote the use of data, visual controls, staffing boards, production records, and shift communication to improve daily decision-making.

**People** **Leadership** **and Culture**
-----------------------------------------

* Build, develop, and retain a strong Plymouth operations leadership team, including supervisors, leads, technical roles, production support, and front-line employees.
* Establish a culture of accountability, teamwork, respect, safety, sanitation, continuous improvement, and pride in Taher's standards.
* Develop succession plans, training routines, onboarding support, and leadership development for critical production kitchen roles.
* Promote effective communication across shifts, departments, and support teams so employees understand the plan, the priorities, and the standard.

**Benefits**
------------

Medical & Dental

Doctegrity Telemedical

401k

Sick Time

Vacation Time

Lifemart Corporate Discount program

Bonus structure

Free turkey for Thanksgiving

**Who We Are:**
---------------

Taher, Inc. is a family-owned and operated, chef-driven, food service management company. We specialize in providing K-12 school lunch management, campus dining, senior dining, catering, vending, and office beverage services to clients in our growing nationwide footprint.

Customers choose Taher for its chef-developed recipes created from natural and sustainable local sources, and for delivering the latest in culinary trends and operational resources to provide outstanding food options for our guests. Taher maintains a consistent presence in Food Service Management's Top 25 companies.

Requirements:

**Qualifications**
==================

* Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Engineering, Food Science, Business, Culinary Operations, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in food production, commissary, production kitchen, packaged food, convenience retail food, or related high-volume food manufacturing environment.
* Experience leading multi-shift production teams, production supervisors, line leads, technical staff, sanitation, and quality support functions.
* Demonstrated success improving production output, labor efficiency, staffing stability, quality performance, sanitation execution, and operational discipline.
* Strong working knowledge of food safety, HACCP, GMPs, sanitation, allergen controls, labeling, traceability, regulatory requirements, and production documentation.
* Experience with Lean, continuous improvement, visual management, production metrics, root cause problem solving, and equipment reliability practices.
* Proven ability to manage operating budgets, staffing plans, production schedules, capital projects, and cross-functional priorities.
* Strong financial, analytical, communication, coaching, and team-building skills.

**Required Skills and Experience**
==================================

* Proven leadership in high-volume food production, commissary, production kitchen, packaged food, convenience retail food, or related manufacturing environments.
* Strong knowledge of food safety, sanitation, HACCP, GMPs, allergen control, labeling, traceability, audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multi-shift teams, production supervisors, line leads, technical employees, sanitation teams, quality support, and front-line employees.
* Experience managing operating budgets, labor models, production schedules, capital projects, equipment priorities, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong analytical, communication, coaching, problem-solving, and team-building skills.
* Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on daily execution in a fast-paced production environment.

Pay Transparency In order to support the Fair Compensation Strategy by the US Govt., HR Dept., clients are required to adhere to "Pay Transparency Law"; in the impacted states; that have mandated the employers to list the salary ranges in Job advertisements or postings for job opportunities and Job promotions.

new_roles.title: VP Operations
new_roles.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions. 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence. 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance. 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include, but not limited to the following.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support.
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact.
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance.
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements.
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability.
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations.
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements.
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives.
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies.
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: **Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring.**

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions.
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation.
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.
* Proven experience developing and executing operational improvement initiatives with measurable business results.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing competing operational priorities in a manufacturing plant.
* Support change management and transactional integrity within the new ERP, Microsoft Dynamics - D365.
* Expertise in methodologies like Lean or Six Sigma to streamline plant throughput and reduce waste.
* Exhibits solid judgement along with decision making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal, analytical and presentation skills.
* Must read, speak and write English fluently.
* Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and planning skills.
* High degree of professional integrity, ethics and confidentiality.
* Ability to learn company ERP. Requires advances proficiency with MS Office suite i.e. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* Base salary range $209,000-235,000, plus management incentive bonus plan
* BCBS of Illinois Medical & Dental. Vision Service Plan.
* 401(k) Savings Plan + generous company match
* Paid time off with 11 annual Holidays
* Disability, Family, & Military Leave
* Life Insurance, Identity Protection, and more!

Relocation assistance is not available. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Daubert Chemical Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Disability/Veteran.

new_roles.title: Head of Plant Operations
new_roles.description:
Description:

**Who we are and what we value:**

Feed Energy works at the intersection of feed, fuel, and agriculture, building a nearly four-decade legacy of stewardship across the industries we serve. We support how America nourishes its people and powers its economy. Our team is made up of growth-minded individuals dedicated to transforming global practices in feeding and fueling. We create circular economies through sustainable, low-carbon products and processes. Join us if you are looking for a dynamic environment where you can help shape a more sustainable future.

**We help feed the world by providing safe, energy-based nutrition solutions.**

Creativity • Stewardship • Impact • Integrity • Healthy Relationships

**What we are looking for:**The Head of Plant Operations is a highly visible, hands-on leader responsible for operational performance across all Feed Energy manufacturing facilities. This role leads Plant Managers and the Senior Operations Support Manager, establishes consistent operating standards, and ensures the plants function as one integrated operating system.The Head of Plant Operations owns the execution of safety, quality, production, cost, reliability, and continuous improvement priorities across all locations. A key focus of the position is developing plant leadership capability, reinforcing accountability, and building the operating discipline required to deliver consistent results. This position reports to the Chief Operations Officer and requires up to 60% travel.

**What you will do:**

* Lead day-to-day operational execution across Feed Energy’s four manufacturing locations.
* Own plant performance targets, including throughput, yield, uptime, labor efficiency, cost per unit, and total operating cost.
* Establish consistent daily, weekly, and monthly operating routines, KPI reporting, and escalation processes.
* Maintain a visible presence on plant floors by observing work, coaching leaders, supporting problem-solving, and building relationships with frontline employees.
* Manage Plant Managers and the Senior Operations Support Manager, setting clear expectations and reinforcing accountability for results.
* Develop Plant Managers, supervisors, and frontline leaders through coaching, feedback, and hands-on leadership support.
* Manage plant operating expenses, including labor, maintenance, utilities, consumables, and outside services, within the approved operational budget.
* Partner with Finance on expense forecasting, variance management, and operating cost inputs for capital planning.
* Lead the daily execution of safety and environmental programs in partnership with the Environmental Health and Safety team.
* Uphold product quality standards and partner with Quality to reduce defects, product holds, and customer quality concerns.
* Build and enforce consistent operating standards and standard operating procedures across all locations.
* Eliminate unnecessary differences in processes, practices, and performance between plants.
* Apply Lean, Six Sigma, root cause analysis, and structured problem-solving as part of daily operations.
* Coordinate operational priorities across Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, and Culture and Talent.
* Model servant leadership and build a culture of safety, ownership, accountability, development, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate Feed Energy company values in all everyday work interactions.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**What you will need:**

* At least 10 years of progressive leadership experience in manufacturing operations.
* Proven experience directly leading multi-site operations, including three or more facilities.
* Demonstrated success building and implementing operating systems across multiple locations.
* Experience managing operating expenses and delivering cost performance within budget.
* Strong experience coaching and developing Plant Managers, operations leaders, supervisors, and frontline teams.
* A servant leadership mindset with the ability to establish clear expectations and accountability.
* Willingness to spend substantial time in manufacturing facilities and personally engage in operational problem-solving.
* Strong working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or comparable continuous improvement methodologies.
* Ability to partner effectively across operational, technical, financial, and people-focused functions.
* Ability to travel up to 60%.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* Advanced degree in Engineering.
* Experience in feed, food, chemical, lipid, or other process-manufacturing environments.
* Previous experience as a Plant Manager.
* Experience scaling operations during organizational growth or technology transitions.
* Experience using ERP and MRP systems, such as SAP or Oracle

**What we provide, because we care!**

In addition to a competitive annual salary, this position will be eligible for an annual performance-based bonus. We offer a full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and wellness reimbursement, a generous 401(k) match of up to 6%, paid time off and holidays, and continuing education support. 
**Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa support. The company will not sponsor employment visas at this time.**

new_roles.title: Head of Production
new_roles.description:
**WHO WE ARE** 
At Ghirardelli, we honor tradition and drive innovation, aiming to be the top choice for premium chocolate. Our commitment to *Making Life A Bite Better* inspires both our products and the way we do business. We support personal and professional growth, recognizing that each employee’s contribution directly impacts Ghirardelli’s growth and success. Join our dynamic team and help shape Ghirardelli's future.

**Job Summary**

The Head of Production is accountable for safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective production across all three shifts of the factory. This role leads the production organization, establishes consistent operating standards and management routines across shifts, and ensures delivery of safety, food safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, waste, and people objectives.

The Head of Production translates factory strategy into clear production priorities, develops leadership capability throughout the production organization, creates the accountability required for sustained execution and deliver on key organizational metrics. The role partners and collaborates cross-functionally to resolve systemic losses, strengthen operating discipline, improve asset and labor performance, and embed TPM and continuous improvement practices into daily operations.

 
 

* Establish and sustain a culture of Safety and Food Safety, shifting the mindset to one of immediate intervention, learning, correction, and prevention of unsafe behaviors or conditions.
* Ensure production leaders visibly demonstrate safety and food-safety leadership on every shift
* Ensure timely containment, investigation, corrective action, and verification following significant incidents or deviations
* Partner with Safety and Quality to ensure standards are understood, implemented, audited, and sustained
* Ensure production readiness for internal, customer, and regulatory audits
* Lead, coach, and develop the production team to ensure clear expectations, accountability, and effective succession plans
* Establish consistent leadership expectations and operating discipline across all three shifts
* Ensure recognition, coaching, corrective action, and performance management are applied consistently across shifts
* Create an environment where standards are understood, leaders address deviations promptly, and follow-through is visible
* Identify systemic losses and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions are implemented
* Sponsor cross-functional improvement teams addressing systemic production losses
* Lead the AM pillar implementation into the culture and mindset of the factory
* Verify that corrective actions address root causes and prevent recurrence across applicable shifts and production areas
* Drive recovery plans when production performance deviates from plan
* Manage production spending, labor, overtime, material variances, and productivity commitments
* Ensure production capacity, labor capability, and operating constraints are represented in annual and long-term planning
* Partner with Maintenance and Reliability to align production plans, preventive maintenance, equipment access, shutdown execution, and chronic-loss elimination
* Partner with Planning and Warehouse to align production schedules, material availability, inventory requirements, and service priorities
* Partner with Quality to manage holds, deviations, and release priorities
* Partner with Engineering on design reviews, commissioning, qualifications, start-up, stabilization, and operational handoff of capital projects
* Partner with Training on workforce planning, leadership capability, and capability development plans
* Partner with HR and factory leadership on labor relations, grievance resolution, contract administration, negotiations, mediation, and arbitration, as required.
* Hire, develop and manage performance of team. Create an inclusive environment that embraces our values and purpose.
* Ensure reconciliation of production workorders and partner with finance function to reconcile and resolve any losses
* Partner with IP team for execution of projects to systematically reduce waste across processing and packaging streams
* Enable a proactive, positive, collaborative and engaged culture across all levels of the production organization
* Complete special projects and other duties as assigned or as necessary.
 

 

Minimum Education and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations management, food science, supply chain, business, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience in a complex, multi-shift operation
* Experience leading managers and an organization with multiple levels of leadership
* Demonstrated accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, productivity and people results
* Experience in food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or another regulated manufacturing environment
* Working knowledge of food-safety systems, manufacturing quality systems, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Experience applying Lean, TPM, or another structured continuous-improvement system
* Experience with labor planning, operating budgets, and performance management
* Ability to lead effectively in a union-represented environment
 

 

Other Job Requirements

* Regular presence in manufacturing and production areas is required
* Flexibility to work across all three shifts to provide leadership visibility, conduct reviews, coach leaders, and respond to operational needs.
* Availability outside of normal business hours for significant safety, food safety, quality, people, equipment, or service events
* Ability to operate in manufacturing environments involving noise, heat, cold, moving equipment, stairs, elevated areas, and required PPE
* Limited travel may be required for business meetings, training, supplier visits, benchmarking, or project support
 

 

Salary: $168766 to $219374

 
 

Ghirardelli's salary range reflects market rates based on our size, revenue, and location. Starting pay is determined using a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, job-related skills, knowledge, and experience as well as market conditions. A bonus and/or long-term incentive may be included as part of this compensation package.

 
 

Ghirardelli is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any other classification protected by state, local or federal law. Where permitted by law, applicants for this position may be required to undergo job‑related background and drug screening. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with relevant state and local fair chance laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the New York City Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

new_roles.title: Director, SAP Supply Chain Planning & Manufacturing Systems
new_roles.description:
**About Monster Energy:**
-------------------------

Forget about blending in. That's not our style. We're the risk-takers, the trailblazers, the game-changers. We're not perfect, and we don't pretend to be. We're raw, unfiltered, and a bit unconventional. But our drive is unrivaled, just like our athletes. The power is in your hands to define what success looks like and where you want to take your career. It's not just about what we do, but about who we become along the way. We are much more than a brand here. We are a way of life, a mindset. Join us.

**A day in the life:**
----------------------

As the Director, SAP Supply Chain Planning & Manufacturing Systems, you will own the design, implementation, and optimization of Monster's end-to-end supply chain planning landscape within the SAP ecosystem. Your primary focus is SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) covering demand planning, supply planning, S&OP, inventory optimization, order based planning and the roadmap of S/4HANA.

You will also guide the connected Manufacturing and Quality solutions, including SAP PP, PP/DS, production execution, and SAP QM, so that planning decisions flow cleanly into the plant floor and quality processes. You will set global processes, solution architecture, and governance; lead a team of SAP IT professionals; and partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Quality leaders to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

**The impact you'll make:**
---------------------------

***Supply Chain Planning (primary focus)***

* Own the global SAP planning solution, with SAP IBP and SAP APO (DP, SNP, PP/DS) as the core platforms, and define the target architecture and roadmap, including to S/4HANA.
* Lead solution design and configuration decisions across demand planning, supply planning, S&OP, inventory optimization, and response/deployment planning.
* Lead planning projects from inception to completion, including implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and migrations, delivered on time, in scope, and on budget.
* Establish planning master data standards, parameter governance, and integration between IBP/APO, S/4HANA, and connected systems (e.g., RTI, CPI).
* Serve as the point of contact on emerging trends in supply chain planning and evaluate solutions that improve forecast accuracy, service levels, and inventory performance.

***Manufacturing & Quality (supporting scope)***

* Oversee SAP production execution solutions so that plans translate into executable production schedules across plants and co-manufacturers.
* Guide SAP QM processes, including inspection planning, batch management, quality notifications, and release, in partnership with Quality and Regulatory teams.
* Ensure end-to-end integration across Planning, Manufacturing, and Quality so the business runs on one consistent process.

***Leadership & strategy***

* Analyze business requirements, prioritize based on cost/benefit, and present a clear implementation roadmap to IT and business leadership.
* Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global team of SAP specialists and manage system integrator and partner relationships.
* Partner closely with end-to-end solution verticals to understand requirements, manage business risk, and deliver quality outcomes on budget and timeline.
* Engage operations leaders to identify problems suited to AI, automation, and advanced analytics, in line with the Digital Transformation (DT) roadmap and vision.

**Who you are:**
----------------

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* 10+ years of SAP supply chain experience working on the IT side, including hands-on process mapping, solution design, configuration, and customization.
* **7+ years of hands-on SAP IBP and/or SAP APO experience**, including at least one full-lifecycle implementation you led or owned. APO-to-IBP migration experience strongly preferred.
* Working experience with SAP PP, and production execution, and exposure to SAP QM. Depth here is valued but secondary to Planning.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP SCM implementations as part of an IT team.
* Proven track record making solution design and roadmap decisions and leading SAP teams and system integrators.
* Experience aligning teams to a common business process and driving application adoption.

***Preferred***

* Certifications: SAP IBP, APICS (CPIM/CSCP), SAP Manufacturing, or SAP Quality.
* Experience in consumer packaged goods, beverage, or other high-volume manufacturing environments.
* Background with automation and analytics tools and platforms (e.g., RPA, workflow automation, process mining, AI/ML forecasting).
* Technical skills: SAP IBP, SAP APO (DP, SNP, PP/DS), S/4HANA, SAP PP, SAP QM, SAP Analytics Cloud, and Microsoft tools.

Monster Energy uses AI-powered tools, including Greenhouse's Talent Matching feature, to help evaluate applications for this role. To learn more see Monster's privacy policy here Privacy Policy or contact Monster at privacy@monsterenergy.com.

For United States applicants: 
Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor. 
Read our privacy policy here: Privacy Policy

new_roles.title: Director, Kinder Bueno Production Operations
new_roles.description:
Manufacturing

Job ID:

78426

Bloomington, IL, US (On-Site)

Permanent

 

About the Role:

We have a current opening for a Senior Production Manager, Kinder Bueno and are actively reviewing applications.

Reporting to the Plant Manager, you will be responsible for leading, directing, and overseeing all day-to-day production operations for Kinder Bueno, ensuring that operational objectives, production targets, and quality standards are consistently achieved in a safe, efficient, and cost-effective manner.

You will provide strategic and operational leadership to the production team, driving continuous improvement, operational excellence, and the development of innovative solutions to enhance product quality, productivity, and overall manufacturing performance.

You will serve as a key point of reference for all activities related to product development, process optimization, and innovation. Through effective leadership, collaboration, and resource management, you will ensure alignment with company objectives while fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

You will be responsible for upholding and promoting all company policies, procedures, and operational standards, with particular emphasis on food safety, quality assurance, environmental responsibility, and health and safety.

 

Main Responsibilities:

Production & Operational Management

* Lead and oversee daily production activities to ensure production schedules, operational targets, and delivery commitments are consistently met.
* Ensure finished products are manufactured in accordance with established quality standards, specifications, and production timelines.
* Manage, support, and continuously develop a team of Production Supervisors, providing direction, guidance, and accountability to ensure effective execution of production plans.
* Partner with the Planning Department and Production Supervisors to develop, coordinate, and execute weekly production schedules.
* Monitor production performance, identify operational challenges, and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency, productivity, and cost effectiveness.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on identifying and eliminating technical, technological, and operational challenges across production lines.
* Identify opportunities to optimize manufacturing processes, improve equipment performance, reduce waste, and maximize operational efficiency.
* Coordinate the implementation of new projects, including production lines, product formats, processes, and technological improvements within the assigned area.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including but not limited to R&D, supply chain, and quality and food safety to support product development, process innovation, and the introduction of new manufacturing capabilities.

**Budget, Maintenance & Resource Management**

* Play a key role in the development, management, and monitoring of the budget, including maintenance, capital investments, production costs, general expenses, and energy consumption.
* Establish maintenance priorities and coordinate interventions in collaboration with the RDM and Maintenance Manager.
* Contribute to the development, review, and continuous improvement of preventive maintenance plans to maximize equipment reliability and operational performance.
* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to support production objectives while maintaining cost controls and operational efficiency.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Translate and communicate company objectives into clear goals and expectations for the management team.
* Provide effective leadership, coaching, and development to Production Supervisors and their teams.
* Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and establish development opportunities to strengthen individual and team performance.
* Maintain constructive working relationships with labor unions and provide guidance and support to UGP management on effective labor relations practices.

**Safety, Quality & Environmental Compliance**

* Ensure full compliance with company policies, procedures, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) across all production activities.
* Promote and reinforce a strong culture of food safety, product quality, and health and safety throughout the production organization.
* Partner with the ISEE Manager to develop and implement initiatives that improve environmental performance and sustainability.
* Ensure employees understand and consistently adhere to applicable regulatory requirements, company standards, and safe operating practices.

About You:

* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related field required.
* A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing or production management. Experience working in a chocolate / confectionery manufacturing or industrial production environment highly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience overseeing production operations, managing teams, and achieving operational and financial performance objectives.
* Strong understanding of raw materials, manufacturing processes, production technologies, quality control, cost management, and production optimization.
* Solid knowledge of business and management principles, including strategic planning, budgeting, resource allocation, workforce planning, leadership, and operational coordination.
* Knowledge of employee relations, labor relations, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), personnel development, and conflict resolution.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities for improvement, solve complex operational challenges, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Working knowledge of production equipment, machinery, and fundamental operating principles within the assigned production area.

**Artificial Intelligence Disclosure**
 
As part of our recruitment process, Ferrero may use artificial intelligence (AI) enabled tools to assist with reviewing candidate applications. These tools are used solely to support recruiters by summarizing application information and identifying potential alignment with job requirements. AI does not independently screen out or select candidates, and it does not replace human judgment. Final decisions regarding candidate progression are always made by Ferrero recruiters and hiring managers.

The base compensation range for this position is $135,453 - $180,604. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors permitted by law. This range represents the anticipated salary for this position at this time.

In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits.

About Ferrero:

Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many **iconic brands** sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com.

DE&I at Ferrero:

Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding.
 
Find out more *here*.

Ferrero is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable human rights laws. Ferrero will recruit, hire, train, and promote all persons without regard to race, creed, color, sex (including pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, and gender identity), religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, or history of disability (except where physical or mental abilities are a bona fide occupational requirement and the individual is not able to perform the essential functions of the position even with reasonable accommodations), citizenship, or any other protected characteristic.

Ferrero will accommodate the needs of applicants with disabilities throughout all stages of the selection process. If you need accommodation during the recruitment process, please advise the People & Organization (HR) Representative. Information relating to the need for accommodation and accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

 

**Our Application Process**
---------------------------

We’re constantly looking for talented individuals who are ready to be part of our dynamic and growing organization. Ferrero is a company with a global presence and family values. Join us!

##### **1. Apply**

Complete your online application, upload your CV and include brief cover letter to help us understand your experience and interests

##### **2. Assess**

Our HR team will arrange a phone or video interview if we feel your qualifications are a good match for the job

##### **3. Interview**

If the first interview goes well, you’ll be invited to speak with a Ferrero manager to assess your competencies, technical aptitude and fit within our dynamic organization

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Advanced Mission Partners, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Science Systems and Applications, Inc (SSAI) seeks a Director of Operations to provide strategic and operational leadership across our aerospace component manufacturing, electronics manufacturing, and engineering services operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing daily operations, optimizing manufacturing performance, managing resources, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality products and engineering services. This position will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, improving profitability, strengthening customer relationships, and supporting the company's continued growth. 
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in aerospace and defense manufacturing, demonstrated leadership experience, and a proven ability to manage complex manufacturing operations while meeting demanding quality, cost, and delivery requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree (BS) in Engineering, Manufacturing, Business Administration, Project Management, Operations Management, or a related technical discipline.
* 12+ years of progressively responsible experience in program management, project management, manufacturing operations, or engineering.
* At least 5 years of experience managing complex technical or manufacturing programs, preferably within the aerospace, defense, or electronics manufacturing industries.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations, managing budgets, and improving operational performance.
* Experience working with aerospace and defense customers, including government agencies, prime contractors, and commercial aerospace organizations.
* Working knowledge of manufacturing processes, engineering development, quality assurance, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and implementing operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong financial, analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Experience in aerospace component manufacturing, electronics manufacturing services (EMS), or precision manufacturing.
* Familiarity with printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), electronic systems integration, and aerospace manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, IPC standards, and applicable aerospace quality requirements.
* Experience with government contracts, including FAR, DFARS, ITAR, and EAR requirements.
* Familiarity with Earned Value Management (EVM), program financial forecasting, and cost control methodologies.
* Experience using Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and project management software, such as Microsoft Project or equivalent tools.
* Experience supporting new product introduction (NPI), production transitions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Demonstrated experience with manufacturing automation, process optimization, and production scalability.

**EOE, including disability/vets**

***Physical Requirements:*** *While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and use hands to touch, handle or feel objects, tools or controls. The employee frequently is required to talk and hear and occasionally required to reach with hands and arms and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.*

**WHO WE ARE** 
At Ghirardelli, we honor tradition and drive innovation, aiming to be the top choice for premium chocolate. Our commitment to *Making Life A Bite Better* inspires both our products and the way we do business. We support personal and professional growth, recognizing that each employee’s contribution directly impacts Ghirardelli’s growth and success. Join our dynamic team and help shape Ghirardelli's future.

**Job Summary**

The Head of Production is accountable for safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-effective production across all three shifts of the factory. This role leads the production organization, establishes consistent operating standards and management routines across shifts, and ensures delivery of safety, food safety, quality, service, cost, productivity, waste, and people objectives.

The Head of Production translates factory strategy into clear production priorities, develops leadership capability throughout the production organization, creates the accountability required for sustained execution and deliver on key organizational metrics. The role partners and collaborates cross-functionally to resolve systemic losses, strengthen operating discipline, improve asset and labor performance, and embed TPM and continuous improvement practices into daily operations.

 

* Establish and sustain a culture of Safety and Food Safety, shifting the mindset to one of immediate intervention, learning, correction, and prevention of unsafe behaviors or conditions.
* Ensure production leaders visibly demonstrate safety and food-safety leadership on every shift
* Ensure timely containment, investigation, corrective action, and verification following significant incidents or deviations
* Partner with Safety and Quality to ensure standards are understood, implemented, audited, and sustained
* Ensure production readiness for internal, customer, and regulatory audits
* Lead, coach, and develop the production team to ensure clear expectations, accountability, and effective succession plans
* Establish consistent leadership expectations and operating discipline across all three shifts
* Ensure recognition, coaching, corrective action, and performance management are applied consistently across shifts
* Create an environment where standards are understood, leaders address deviations promptly, and follow-through is visible
* Identify systemic losses and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions are implemented
* Sponsor cross-functional improvement teams addressing systemic production losses
* Lead the AM pillar implementation into the culture and mindset of the factory
* Verify that corrective actions address root causes and prevent recurrence across applicable shifts and production areas
* Drive recovery plans when production performance deviates from plan
* Manage production spending, labor, overtime, material variances, and productivity commitments
* Ensure production capacity, labor capability, and operating constraints are represented in annual and long-term planning
* Partner with Maintenance and Reliability to align production plans, preventive maintenance, equipment access, shutdown execution, and chronic-loss elimination
* Partner with Planning and Warehouse to align production schedules, material availability, inventory requirements, and service priorities
* Partner with Quality to manage holds, deviations, and release priorities
* Partner with Engineering on design reviews, commissioning, qualifications, start-up, stabilization, and operational handoff of capital projects
* Partner with Training on workforce planning, leadership capability, and capability development plans
* Partner with HR and factory leadership on labor relations, grievance resolution, contract administration, negotiations, mediation, and arbitration, as required.
* Hire, develop and manage performance of team. Create an inclusive environment that embraces our values and purpose.
* Ensure reconciliation of production workorders and partner with finance function to reconcile and resolve any losses
* Partner with IP team for execution of projects to systematically reduce waste across processing and packaging streams
* Enable a proactive, positive, collaborative and engaged culture across all levels of the production organization
* Complete special projects and other duties as assigned or as necessary.

Minimum Education and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations management, food science, supply chain, business, or a related field
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience in a complex, multi-shift operation
* Experience leading managers and an organization with multiple levels of leadership
* Demonstrated accountability for safety, quality, service, cost, productivity and people results
* Experience in food, beverage, consumer packaged goods, or another regulated manufacturing environment
* Working knowledge of food-safety systems, manufacturing quality systems, and applicable regulatory requirements
* Experience applying Lean, TPM, or another structured continuous-improvement system
* Experience with labor planning, operating budgets, and performance management
* Ability to lead effectively in a union-represented environment

Other Job Requirements

* Regular presence in manufacturing and production areas is required
* Flexibility to work across all three shifts to provide leadership visibility, conduct reviews, coach leaders, and respond to operational needs.
* Availability outside of normal business hours for significant safety, food safety, quality, people, equipment, or service events
* Ability to operate in manufacturing environments involving noise, heat, cold, moving equipment, stairs, elevated areas, and required PPE
* Limited travel may be required for business meetings, training, supplier visits, benchmarking, or project support

Salary: $168766 to $219374

To learn more about our benefits visit Corporate Careers | Ghirardelli, and select "Learn More" under Corporate, Manufacturing or Restaurant & Retail.

Ghirardelli's salary range reflects market rates based on our size, revenue, and location. Starting pay is determined using a wide range of factors including, but not limited to, job-related skills, knowledge, and experience as well as market conditions. A bonus and/or long-term incentive may be included as part of this compensation package.

Ghirardelli is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, age, veteran status, or any other classification protected by state, local or federal law. Where permitted by law, applicants for this position may be required to undergo job‑related background and drug screening. Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with relevant state and local fair chance laws, including the California Fair Chance Act and the New York City Fair Chance Act, where applicable.
