new_roles.title: Director of Transit Products Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**DIRECTOR OF TRANSIT PRODUCTS MANUFACTURING**

**Position Summary**

Reporting directly to the President, the Director of Transit Products Manufacturing is responsible for providing strategic leadership and operational oversight for all Transit Products manufacturing operations. This role drives operational excellence through continuous improvement, cost optimization, productivity enhancement, quality assurance, and workforce development while supporting the company's growth objectives.

The Director partners closely with Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance, and Human Resources to align manufacturing capacity and performance with customer demand, financial objectives, and long-term business strategy. The successful candidate will foster a culture of accountability, safety, continuous improvement, and employee engagement while delivering exceptional operational results.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities as management may deem necessary from time to time.*

**Leadership & Strategy**

* Provide leadership and direction for all Transit Products manufacturing operations.
* Develop and execute manufacturing strategies that support company growth, profitability, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction objectives.
* Partner with the Executive Team to establish departmental goals, priorities, budgets, and long-term operational plans.
* Lead organizational change initiatives and continuous improvement efforts across manufacturing functions.
* Build and maintain a high-performance culture through coaching, accountability, employee engagement, and leadership development.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure manufacturing operations consistently achieve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives.
* Oversee the execution of production plans to meet customer commitments while optimizing labor, equipment, and facility utilization.
* Identify operational constraints, process inefficiencies, and capacity limitations, and lead corrective actions to improve performance.
* Establish, monitor, and communicate key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive data-based decision making and accountability.
* Develop and implement initiatives that improve throughput, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and lower operational costs.
* Champion Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies throughout the organization.

**Quality & Safety**

* Maintain a safe working environment and ensure compliance with all company policies, safety regulations, and applicable laws.
* Promote a culture where safety, quality, and continuous improvement are fundamental operating principles.
* Ensure products consistently meet or exceed customer specifications and quality standards.
* Support root cause analysis and corrective action activities to prevent recurring quality and operational issues.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Sales, Operations Planning, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Finance to align manufacturing performance with sales forecasts, customer demand, inventory requirements, and financial goals.
* Partner with Engineering to support new product introductions, process improvements, and manufacturability initiatives.
* Work closely with the ERP team to maximize the utilization and effectiveness of ERP systems and related technologies to improve operational visibility and performance.

**People Development**

* Develop, mentor, and build strategies to retain manufacturing leaders and team members.
* Establish clear performance expectations and provide regular coaching, feedback, and development opportunities.
* Support succession planning and organizational development to ensure long-term operational stability and growth.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Participate in daily operational reviews to address production performance, scheduling, delivery commitments, and operational issues.
* Prepare and present operational performance updates, improvement initiatives, and strategic plans to executive leadership.
* As a member of the AROW Global leadership team, understand and support the AROW Business System, policies, objectives, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including at least 5 years in a senior management role.
* Demonstrated success leading manufacturing operations in a growth-oriented environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, and team development skills.
* Experience managing budgets, operational metrics, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems; IFS experience preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

**Preferred**

* Experience in Transit, Transportation, Bus, Specialty Vehicle, Metal Fabrication, or Industrial Manufacturing environments.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement certification and experience.
* Proven track record of implementing operational excellence initiatives that improve quality, delivery performance, productivity, and profitability.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, communicate, hear, and use hands to handle tools, equipment, and office materials. Periodic business travel will be required on an infrequent basis.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

AROW is an Equal Opportunity and Human Rights Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, provincial, and local employment laws at its U.S. and Canadian locations.

new_roles.title: Plant Director
new_roles.description:
**SUMMARY:**

The Plant Director oversees and manages the overall manufacturing effort of the Rochester Site. He/she is responsible for the profit and loss of the facility through the coordination and management of manufacturing, tooling, human resources, quality assurance, finance, and continuous improvement for the location in support of the overall company objectives. May take part in development of functional strategy. Leads the site's use of AI and automation, in the office and on the shop floor, to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

At Crenlo we invest in our people. Our overall success is contributed to our employees' skills and talents, which have been impactful and essential to the growth of our business. Here, you will get the opportunity to test your knowledge and skills and become a critical player.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Directs the overall operations of the facility and all departments within
* Establish sound strategies and tactics aimed towards continued quality, safety, cost improvement and OTD (on-time delivery) of products
* Oversee management review of quality systems and encourages a lean operation by driving continuous improvement, proactive management, and teamwork
* Ensure that facility is properly staffed and trained
* Represents facility to potential customers, clients, and at corporate meetings
* Bears overall responsibility for housekeeping of facility and safety awareness
* Communicates plant financial & operational condition to Corporate
* Manage the operations cost to enhance profitability while staying within legal guidelines and company policies and procedures
* Responsible for the strategy and long-term planning of the operations to ensure continued success in meeting customer expectations
* **Office AI streamlining:** Use AI tools to cut manual work in reporting, daily management prep, shortage and expedite lists, shift reports, and Oracle EBS data cleanup (lead times, BOMs), so leaders spend less time building spreadsheets and more time on the floor
* **Shop floor AI deployment:** Lead pilots and rollout of AI and vision tools on the shop floor. Select AI and automation projects by payback, run pilots, measure results against plant KPIs, and scale what works
* Keep Oracle EBS and shop floor data accurate enough for AI tools to use
* Comply and follow all procedures within the company's IT security policy, including the use of AI tools and protection of customer data and drawings
* May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned

**KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong commitment to Crenlo Operating System to drive continuous improvement
 + Strategy Deployment: Break through objectives, action plans, metrics, countermeasures

new_roles.title: Strategic Account Director - Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Description:**
================

SPS Commerce is a leading provider of cloud-based supply chain management solutions, serving a global network of retail trading partners. We foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment where innovation and continuous improvement are highly valued. Join SPS Commerce and be part of a dynamic team that's transforming the global retail supply chain!

**Position Summary:**
=====================

As a Manufacturing Strategic Account Director, you will work with manufacturers and brands of all sizes (with focus on mid-market and enterprise organizations from $70M - $1B+ in annual revenue) to automate the exchange of crucial supply chain data and drive/manage change with their supplier community. The role will focus on working with current Manufacturing subscribers of SPS Relationship Management to expand and grow the partnership through upsell and cross-sell. This is a quota-carrying, fast-paced role for a critical thinker who communicates with confidence and presence, stays organized across a large territory, and collaborates well with others. 
 

This is a quota-carrying, fast-paced role for a critical thinker who communicates with confidence, stays organized across a large territory, and collaborates well with others.

### **What You'll Do**

* Learn and apply the Relationship Management for Manufacturing go-to-market methodology, adapting as the content evolves.
* Run a value-based sales process and manage a defined territory, from identifying and developing opportunities through close.
* Serve as the primary relationship owner for current Manufacturing customers, driving growth through: Additional phases of supplier onboarding across supplier segments, order types, and shipping models Product add-ons such as Visibility Management Maximizing Ongoing Supplier Onboarding where applicable
* Assess each customer's situation, priorities, and stakeholders, then choose and sequence the right sales tools, resources, and SPS partners to move the opportunity forward.
* Manage contractual events such as scope increases and decreases.
* Work closely with SPS account teams to align on customer details and account strategy, share key information openly, and build support for customer success.
* Maintain a rolling 90-day pipeline to meet or exceed your ARR quota.
* Partner with the Strategic Account Executive aligned to your territory as new customers transition to your ownership, and on an ongoing basis as needed.
* Keep customers satisfied by responding promptly and ensuring strong alignment with Customer Success.
Document findings, progress, insights, and pipeline velocity in Salesforce. 

 

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years of quota-carrying sales, **or** some post-secondary education and 9+ years of relevant experience.
* Proven experience managing the full sales cycle: prospecting, building pipeline, handling objections, demonstrating ROI, forecasting accurately, and staying persistent through both short and long cycles.
* Clear, concise, confident communication (verbal, non-verbal, and written), including strong listening skills and the ability to adjust tone to the audience.
* The ability to explain business and technical topics to audiences with varied expertise, and to navigate customer organizations to reach the right stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration with product management, support, sales leadership, and senior management.
* Demonstrated integrity, relationship building, and leadership.

**Preferred**

* Experience with SPS Retail/Community or selling SPS System Automation, including selling to the C-suite across functions such as Merchandising, E-Commerce, Supply Chain, Operations, Logistics, and Finance.
* A track record of building and sustaining executive-level customer relationships.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Salesforce, and a willingness to adopt AI tools such as Claude and CHAMP as they become available.

**Location:** Minneapolis, MN (Hybrid). We are not currently open to candidates who are not local to Minneapolis, MN.

 

### **What We Offer**

**Total annualized on-target compensation: $170,000.** Compensation reflects each employee's experience, performance, and skills. The range for this role considers factors such as education, relevant skills, work history, certifications, and location.

 

Our benefits include health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance; paid time off; a 401(k); health and flexible spending accounts; an employee stock purchase plan; and more.

 

### **Our Commitment to Employees**

At SPS, we power connections that drive the world of commerce forward. Our success depends on making strong decisions, fostering innovation, delivering outstanding customer solutions, and driving business performance. We do that by creating an environment where every employee feels a true sense of belonging, and where everyone is accepted, valued, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

 

We are committed to affirmative action and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

================================

At SPS we power connections that drive the world of commerce forward, and our success depends on making strong decisions, fostering innovation, delivering unparalleled customer solutions, and driving outstanding business performance. We achieve this by creating an environment where every employee feels a true sense of belonging. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring everyone feels accepted, valued, and empowered to make a meaningful impact.

We are committed to affirmative action and equal opportunity in all aspects of employment. new_roles.description:
Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri with more than 1,200 employees and nearing $2B in revenue, Alberici is a diversified construction company that partners with leading organizations throughout North America to build their most challenging and important projects.

Since our founding in 1918, Alberici earned a reputation for executing with quality, safety and trust. Combined with our 100+ years of experience, we provide construction solutions to the automotive, commercial, civil, energy, food & beverage, healthcare, heavy industrial, industrial process, and water industries.

***We build the critical structures that improve lives and strengthen communities.***

Our mission is simple — and our approach to delivering on it is equally straightforward. We are as open and honest with our employees and partners as we are with our clients. We are here to work together to do the best work possible to bring this mission to life.

When it comes to our team, Alberici employees are built differently. We seek the best and brightest and are committed to investing in our people and providing the training and resources they need to learn, grow, and advance. 
 
Are you **Built for the Challenge**?

**Our Values:**

* Working Safely
* Valuing Diversity
* Serving Humbly
* Executing with Integrity
* Solving Creatively
* Engaging Fully

**What We Offer:**

* Profit-sharing plan, cash bonus programs and annual cost-of-living adjustments
* Generous salary increases and per diems for qualified out-of-town assignments
* Health, dental and vision insurance eligibility on day one
* Paid parental leave
* Continuing education reimbursement
* Personalized career development and training programs
* Minimum of 29 days of PTO (including holidays) for entry-level roles
* Fitness center for St. Louis office-based team members
* Gym membership reimbursement for project-based team members
* Corporate office cafeteria access
* Employee Resource Group (ERG) opportunities
* Philanthropy opportunities

*Position Overview:*

The Business Development Director (Industrial / Advanced Manufacturing) is responsible for identifying, originating, and developing qualified business opportunities that expand Alberici’s market presence and support strategic growth throughout North America. This role focuses on identifying prospective clients and emerging capital projects, establishing relationships with senior decision makers, and leveraging market intelligence and professional networks to create new business opportunities.

The Business Development Director partners with Market Leadership, Project Development, and technical experts to understand client needs, position Alberici’s capabilities, and convert early-stage opportunities into qualified pursuits. This role is instrumental in expanding strategic client relationships, creating access to new markets, and supporting Alberici’s long-term growth objectives.

*Market Intelligence & Prospecting*

* Develops and executes strategic business development plans aligned with Alberici's growth objectives, identifying targeted clients, markets, geographies, and emerging opportunities.
* Proactively identifies capital investment programs and project opportunities early in development, leveraging industry relationships, market intelligence, research, and professional networks.
* Monitors industry trends, capital spending, competitive activity, and market developments to identify opportunities and determine effective strategies for early client engagement.
* Develops and maintains relationships with industry organizations, consultants, engineers, suppliers, and other strategic contacts to expand market intelligence, client access, and business opportunities

*Executive Relationship Development*

* Develops and maintains strategic relationships with senior executives, key decision makers, and influencers within targeted client organizations to expand Alberici's market presence and access to new business opportunities.
* Leverages professional networks and industry relationships to establish connections with prospective clients, navigate complex organizations, and strengthen long-term relationships.
* Develops a thorough understanding of prospective clients' business objectives, capital investment priorities, organizational structures, and decision-making processes to identify opportunities for meaningful engagement.
* Creates opportunities for Alberici's Market Leadership and technical experts to engage with prospective clients, effectively communicating the Company's capabilities, experience, and value proposition.

*Opportunity Development & Qualification*

* Converts market intelligence and strategic relationships into qualified business opportunities aligned with Alberici's capabilities, target markets, growth objectives, and risk profile.
* Evaluates prospective opportunities by assessing client business drivers, capital plans, project objectives, decision-making processes, competitive dynamics, and anticipated project timelines.
* Partners with Market Leadership to assess opportunity viability, establish engagement priorities, and determine which opportunities warrant further investment of Company resources.
* Maintains accurate and current information regarding client relationships, market intelligence, and business opportunities within the Company's business development tracking systems.
* Maintains accurate and timely documentation of client relationships, business development activities, qualified opportunities, and strategic engagement plans within Alberici's CRM system (AEC 360), ensuring visibility and accountability across the organization.
* Develops and maintains business development pipelines, opportunity forecasts, and weekly and monthly progress reports, tracking prospective clients, relationship development activities, anticipated opportunities, and planned actions to support strategic planning and growth objectives.

*Internal Engagement & Handoff*

* Identifies the appropriate timing to engage Market Leadership, Project Development, and technical experts in qualified opportunities, facilitating meaningful introductions and client engagement.
* Provides internal teams with relevant client intelligence, business objectives, decision-making dynamics, and competitive insights to support effective positioning and pursuit strategies.
* Partners with Market Leadership and Project Development to ensure a coordinated transition from opportunity development to active pursuit, maintaining continuity in client relationships and strategic positioning.
* Remains engaged as a relationship resource throughout the pursuit process, collaborating across Alberici's markets and operating groups while supporting the appropriate leaders responsible for project solutions and pursuit execution.
* Collaborates with Marketing, Market Leadership, and Project Development throughout the pursuit and proposal process, providing client intelligence and insights into key priorities, challenges, and decision criteria to support effective positioning, messaging, and proposal development.

*Qualifications:*

* Bachelor’s degree within engineering, construction management, marketing or other relevant fields
* Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a business development role within construction, engineering, architecture, or sales
* Proven track record of client and sales acquisition with established relationships in the sectors of advanced manufacturing, defense, aerospace, and/or process manufacturing
* **Must be willing to travel as required**

**Growth Opportunities**

Alberici invests heavily in our team members training and development in both technical, management, and leadership aptitude.

This role is on the business development career ladder; employees participate in a Professional Development Plan (PDP) focused on career advancement.

Typical growth opportunities for this position include:

* Senior Business Development Director, followed by Vice President of Business Development

new_roles.title: Director, Dental Furniture Operations
new_roles.description:
At A-dec, we do more than create the highest quality products and services for the dental industry; we strive to deliver a superior employment experience for each of our team members. With an environment that encourages and assists each person in developing to their highest potential, a career at A-dec is incredibly rewarding.

**Overview**
------------

The Director, Dental Furniture Operations provides strategic direction and end-to-end operational oversight for A-dec’s dental furniture value stream at the Newberg campus. The role leads manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning for the value stream and is accountable for delivering the dental furniture business plan, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost, inventory, and capacity growth. The Director partners with product line leadership and functions across Manufacturing and the enterprise to translate product and demand plans into a scalable, high-mix, engineered-to-order operation, while strengthening woodworking capability and continuous improvement.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* End-to-end performance of the Dental Furniture value stream: safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost, and inventory against the business plan.
* Dental Furniture purchasing and production and materials planning, including supplier performance, material availability, and inventory levels.
* Capacity, workforce, equipment, and space plans that support Dental Furniture growth and new product introductions.
* Leadership bench strength and succession for all managers and critical roles in assigned areas.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead the managers responsible for manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning. Define the area’s operating system, including standards, tiered performance reviews, and escalation paths, and hold managers accountable for meeting customer and company safety, quality, delivery, and cost standards.
* Develop annual business plans and budgets, including key performance indicators; assess current capacity and capability and establish multi-year plans for workforce, equipment, space, and investment to meet forecasted demand and support growth; prepare business cases for capital and expense needs.
* Set direction for Dental Furniture manufacturing engineering, including process technology, automation, and capital project priorities that improve safety, quality, throughput, and cost and strengthen woodworking capability.
* Own purchasing and production and materials planning for the Dental Furniture line, including supplier selection and performance, material availability, and inventory targets; operate within enterprise purchasing policies, partner with Global Sourcing on commodity strategy and shared suppliers, and represent the value stream in the enterprise SIOP process.
* Partner with product line leadership, Product Development, and Marketing to translate product strategy, roadmap, and pricing into executable operational initiatives and support the transition of new products into production.
* Set annual targets for safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and efficiency; own results and lead monthly operating reviews with managers to set priorities and drive systemic corrective action.
* Lead deployment of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement across assigned areas; set and prioritize the improvement portfolio against the business plan and build a culture of creative problem solving, collaboration, learning, and development.
* Ensure operations within assigned areas comply with company safety, regulatory, and quality policies and applicable environmental requirements; partner with Environmental Health and Safety, Quality, and other functions to address risks and sustain compliance.
* Set performance objectives for direct reports, review results, and hold them accountable for achieving annual business objectives; take appropriate corrective action when needed.
* + Own workforce strategy for assigned areas: with managers, assess capabilities, close skill and staffing gaps, and plan labor against forecasted demand. Develop managers and maintain succession plans for critical roles.
 + Partner with People & Culture to lead organizational design, change management, and employee engagement; promote a respectful, inclusive, and people-focused work environment.
 + Partner with the Director, Manufacturing Operations – Machining & Maintenance on machined-component supply, maintenance service levels, and equipment reliability, and with other Manufacturing leaders on shared capabilities and capital priorities that support Dental Furniture operations.
 + Communicate value-stream priorities, performance, risks, and resource needs to executive leadership, peers, and employees.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to lead managers across manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, including high-mix, engineered-to-order production and woodworking or related manufacturing processes.
* Ability to develop and execute business plans, budgets, capacity strategies, and capital priorities aligned with product and business goals.
* Understanding of manufacturing engineering, automation, and capital investment planning.
* Ability to interpret operational and financial data and use performance measures to guide decisions that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and capacity.
* Effective communication, relationship-building, and change leadership skills, including the ability to work across product line leadership, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and make timely decisions in a changing manufacturing environment.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing or operations leadership, including at least four years in a senior leadership role.
* Experience leading production planning, materials planning, and purchasing, with accountability for inventory, supplier performance, and SIOP participation.
* Experience leading lean manufacturing and continuous improvement deployment.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and coordinating multiple functions within a manufacturing value stream.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business, engineering, operations, or a related field.
* Experience in furniture, woodworking, high-mix, engineered-to-order, or medical device manufacturing.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certification.

**Physical Requirements:**

Ability to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise maneuver up to 35 pounds with or without assistance on a routine basis. Must have manual hand dexterity to grasp, operate tools and equipment repetitively. Able to walk, stand, sit, bend, reach, and occasionally kneel, climb steps, and twist throughout an entire shift. Some areas may be exposed to chemicals, noise, vibration and /or dust, and require the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE); such as, but not limited to safety glasses, hearing protection, foot protection, etc.

**Disclaimer**

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not to be construed as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. A-dec reserves the right to assign job duties and days and hours of work based on factors such as workload requirements, staffing levels, and customer demands.

At A-dec, we value our people and show it by prioritizing an inclusive culture, total well-being, and opportunities for learning and career advancement.

**A background check and screen for the illegal use of drugs is required.** 
 
*A-dec is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition, A-dec will not discriminate against applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another. \*VEVRAA Federal Contractor”*

*A-dec is interested in qualified candidates authorized to work in the United States for US-based positions. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas.*

new_roles.title: Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation
new_roles.description:
Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

 

Location: This role is based in Hershey, PA with an expectation of 3 days in office per week.

**About the Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

At The Hershey Company, we make more moments of goodness through some of the world's most iconic brands, including Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat®, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Dot's Pretzels, Lesser Evil and more. Our team supports a global portfolio of over 90 brands, creating opportunities to shape strategies and drive impact across a breadth of businesses that few companies can offer. While many organizations focus on a handful of brands, Hershey provides exposure to a diverse portfolio of category-leading brands enjoyed by consumers around the world. What truly sets us apart is our legacy. Inspired by Milton Hershey's belief that business should create opportunities for others, we have been making a positive impact for more than a century through our commitment to communities, philanthropy, and our longstanding partnership with Milton Hershey School. When you join Hershey, you become part of a company where purpose, growth, and making a difference are woven into how we do business every day.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation serves as the enterprise owner of the Hershey Lean Production System, or HLPS, and leads the continued evolution of Lean manufacturing across Hershey’s global manufacturing network.

 

This leader defines strategy, governance, standards, maturity model, deployment approach and capability requirements for HLPS. The Director partners with plant and functional leaders to eliminate systemic losses, strengthen operator ownership and accelerate manufacturing transformation through digital Lean, connected-worker solutions, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacity optimization.

 

The role ensures a consistent enterprise operating system while enabling each site to deploy HLPS according to its business needs, maturity and performance priorities.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* **Own HLPS strategy and governance:** Define and maintain the HLPS architecture, principles, pillar standards, maturity model, assessment methodology, deployment roadmap and governance routines. Set the multi-year strategy and annual priorities, benchmark externally and translate proven practices into enterprise standards.
* **Lead network deployment:** Partner with Plant Managers to establish site transformation roadmaps, conduct quarterly progress reviews, address enterprise barriers, require recovery plans for material gaps and accelerate the replication of successful practices.
* **Build Lean leadership capability:** Establish role-based capability expectations, learning pathways, qualifications and coaching models for plants, Operational Excellence, engineering and frontline leaders. Build internal coaches and assessors while strengthening Daily Management, Leader Standard Work, structured problem solving, Autonomous Maintenance and Focused Improvement.
* **Advance manufacturing transformation:** Lead strategy and governance for assigned initiatives in digital Lean, connected worker, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacityoptimization. Establish prioritization, pilot criteria, stage gates, value-realization requirements and scalable deployment standards in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain Strategy, Digital/IT and Finance.
* **Deliver measurable business value:** Translate operational losses and capability gaps into an enterprise improvement portfolio. Connect HLPS maturity to safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, productivity and people outcomes, partnering with Finance to validate benefits.
* **Lead and develop the team:** Guide Lean Program Leads and transformation and technical resources, focusing support on the network’s highest-value opportunities.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business or related discipline.
* Master’s degree preferred.

 

**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering or Operational Excellence, including 5+ years leading leaders, multi-site programs or enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation.
* Demonstrated success designing, deploying or materially advancing Lean, Total Productive Maintenance, or a manufacturing operating system across multiple sites.
* Strong knowledge of Lean management systems, TPM, Daily Management, structured problem solving, loss analysis, asset reliability and capability development.
* Proven ability to influence Plant Managers and senior cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, coaching and change-leadership skills.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent demonstrated experience preferred.
* Experience in automated or capital-intensive manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Previous leadership of a manufacturing site, major production operation or enterprise or multi-site Operational Excellence transformation strongly preferred.
* Consumer packaged goods, food and beverage, or other regulated manufacturing experience preferred.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

new_roles.title: Director of Operations (PCNY - Queens)
new_roles.description:
**ABOUT US:** 
With a dedication to our people and our products, The Honickman Companies® are collectively one of the largest independent beverage employers in the country. Our Pepsi business includes distribution for brands like Pepsi-Cola, Starbucks, Lipton Teas, Gatorade, Evian and more, throughout the 5 Borough’s, Long Island, Westchester and Pennsauken NJ. If you are excited to work with some of the biggest brands in the world, in the biggest brand market in the world, come see what we have to offer. a passionate, self-motivated, and detail-oriented team player who is committed to the success of our customers. You will focus on growing and developing existing clients, as well as generating new business by identifying, implementing and executing new strategies.
 
 
**SUMMARY:** 
Leads the day-to-day operations of a large-scale beverage manufacturing facility, with overall accountability for Production, Quality, Maintenance, Shipping, Receiving and Warehousing. Establishes operating priorities and develops leaders and teams to deliver safe, high-quality, cost-effective and efficient production. Applies practical business judgment, disciplined execution and continuous improvement through the Honickman Management Operating System to improve plant performance and support the Company’s business strategy.
 
 
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** 

* Provides visible, hands-on leadership and direction for all plant operations, including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Shipping, Receiving and Warehousing.
* Establishes clear operating priorities, performance expectations and accountability; aligns staffing, resources and production plans with customer and business requirements.
* Ensures production schedules are achieved while meeting safety, food safety, quality, efficiency, cost and customer service expectations.
* Monitors and acts upon key performance indicators, including safety performance, schedule attainment, production efficiency, equipment utilization, downtime, waste, labor productivity, inventory accuracy and service levels.
* Identifies operating constraints and performance gaps; leads root cause analysis, corrective actions and practical solutions that improve throughput, reliability and execution.
* Ensures manufacturing processes, standard operating procedures and controls are documented, consistently followed and improved as business needs evolve.
* Partners with Quality leadership to maintain effective food safety, sanitation, preventive control and quality systems and to resolve customer complaints, audit findings and corrective actions promptly.
* Provides leadership and oversight for preventive and predictive maintenance, work-order execution and equipment reliability; aligns maintenance priorities with production requirements and long-term asset needs.
* Supports capital planning and execution, including equipment upgrades, facility improvements and other investments that improve safety, capacity, reliability or cost performance.
* Oversees warehouse, inventory control, shipping and receiving operations to ensure accurate inventory, efficient material flow, appropriate space utilization and timely customer shipments.
* Drives practical, results-oriented continuous improvement through the Honickman Management Operating System; ensures initiatives produce measurable gains in safety, quality, productivity, waste, cost and equipment effectiveness.
* Develops and manages operating plans and budgets; controls labor, overtime, waste, operating expense and other key financial measures while balancing service and production needs.
* Leads, develops and holds department managers and supervisors accountable; builds leadership capability, cross-functional collaboration and a strong succession pipeline.
* Builds a culture of teamwork, communication, employee engagement and ownership by maintaining a regular presence on the plant floor and engaging employees at all levels.
* Establishes productive relationships with employees and union representatives; ensures consistent application of Company policies, procedures and applicable collective bargaining agreements and addresses employee relations matters promptly and professionally.
* Promotes a proactive safety culture and ensures compliance with applicable OSHA, environmental, food safety, regulatory and customer requirements; directs timely incident investigations and corrective actions.
* Provides accurate and timely operating reports, communicates plant performance and risks, and recommends actions needed to achieve business objectives.
* Performs other related duties as required and assigned

**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:** 
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
 

* Comprehensive knowledge of large-scale manufacturing operations, production planning, equipment reliability, quality systems, food safety, warehousing, distribution and inventory controls.
* Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to develop operating plans, manage budgets and labor costs, interpret performance data and translate findings into action.
* Practical knowledge of continuous improvement, root cause analysis, standard work and performance management; ability to implement solutions that deliver measurable operational results.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a complex operation through multiple levels of management and to establish priorities, accountability and disciplined execution across functions.
* Working knowledge of OSHA, environmental and food-manufacturing regulatory requirements and the ability to maintain effective safety, quality and compliance systems.
* Proven ability to lead and develop managers and supervisors, engage a diverse hourly workforce and build effective labor-management relationships in a union environment.
* Excellent judgment, problem-solving, organizational and follow-up skills; able to manage competing priorities and make timely decisions in a fast-paced operation.
* Effective oral, written and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate expectations, performance, risks and recommendations to employees, leaders and senior management.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook; familiarity with manufacturing, maintenance, warehouse and performance-reporting systems.

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE:** 

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management or a related field preferred; equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will be considered.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience, including prior overall responsibility as a plant, site or operations leader for a large, complex manufacturing facility.
* Prior responsibility for multiple functions, including Production, Quality, Maintenance and Warehouse/Distribution operations, with demonstrated success improving plant performance.
* Beverage manufacturing experience strongly preferred; significant food manufacturing experience will also be considered.
* Experience leading a unionized manufacturing workforce strongly preferred.
* Experience managing operating budgets, labor costs, productivity, equipment reliability, quality, safety and overall plant performance required.
* Any equivalent combination of education, experience and training that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS / WORK ENVIRONMENT / TRAVEL:** 

* Manufacturing, warehouse and office environments; regular presence on the production floor is required.
* Must be able to work around moving equipment, elevated noise levels, temperature variation and other conditions typical of a beverage manufacturing facility, with required personal protective equipment.
* Ability to move throughout the facility and occasionally lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule and respond to operational needs outside normal business hours; limited travel may be required.

**COMPENSATION RANGE:** 
Potential earning is from $190,000.00 - $215,000.00 annually
 
 
The statements herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required by personnel so classified. Furthermore, they do not establish a contract for employment and are subject to change at the discretion of the company.
 
 

* We do not provide application status due to overwhelming volume. If your skills meet our needs, we will contact you to move forward in the process.\*

\*\*EOE without regard to race, color, religion, creed, affectional or sexual orientation or sex, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetics, veteran status, gender, gender identity, citizenship status, marital status, VEVRAA Federal Contractor.\*\*
 
\*\*\*If you have a disability and you need an accommodation to apply, please contact us at hiring@hongrp.com

new_roles.title: Director, HR – U.S. Commercial & Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

This position serves as the senior strategic people leader and trusted advisor to the SVP – U.S. General Manager and the U.S. Executive Leadership Team, overseeing HR for U.S. Field Sales, U.S. Marketing, and U.S. Manufacturing (approximately 950 employees). The leader shapes and executes the HR strategy that enables business objectives and builds the organizational capability and culture required for sustained growth.

**Critical Responsibilities**

* Lead, develop, and inspire the HR team supporting these organizations, setting priorities, performance expectations, and a high-performing culture
* Sit on the U.S. Commercial Leadership Team and the Americas HR Leadership Team, building influential cross-functional partnerships
* Design and deliver business-specific HR solutions that measurably advance business outcomes
* Provide executive-level counsel to senior leaders, managers, and employees
* Provide thought leadership and accountability for culture, integration, organizational design, leadership development, and large-scale change management
* Apply strong analytical skills, strategic judgment, and financial acumen, including knowledge of the organization’s financial position, long-range plans, culture, and competitive landscape, to shape decisions and influence senior stakeholders
* Assess the effectiveness of the organization’s business model and dynamics, and lead realignment as needed to drive performance
* Lead strategic workforce planning and advise senior leadership on hiring, headcount, and organizational design decisions
* Advise site leaders and the HR team on manufacturing employee relations, engagement, and compliance, driving consistent HR practices across U.S. sites

**Risk, Governance & Compliance**

* Bring demonstrable experience in employee relations, labor relations, and compliance, and develop and manage the labor relations strategy
* Advise on organizational change related to automation, restructuring, new product launches, digital transformation, and expansion
* Partner with Legal to mitigate people-related risks and ensure alignment with local regulations and corporate standards

**Key Qualifications**

* Exceptional experience partnering with senior leaders, people managers, and employees in a highly matrixed, multi-site global environment
* Deep expertise across HR disciplines, including integration and transformation, talent acquisition, performance management, compensation, culture and engagement, change management, organizational design, and inclusion & diversity
* Demonstrated executive presence, with the ability to counsel and influence at the most senior levels, collaborate across the business and HR COEs, and communicate exceptionally well
* Proven ability to lead and develop HR professionals, including HR Business Partners, and build a high-performing HR organization
* Experience supporting manufacturing or operations environments, including partnering with plant leadership, managing hourly and salaried workforces, and analyzing labor cost, overtime, absenteeism, and staffing utilization metrics
* Ability to analyze data quickly and provide actionable, strategic business recommendations
* Proven track record of designing and implementing HR strategies that translate organizational strategy into the people agenda and drive measurable business results
* Advanced financial acumen, including the ability to connect people strategy to business financials
* Minimum Bachelor’s degree. MBA or Master’s degree in an HR discipline preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive HR experience, including 7+ years in HR Business Partner or senior HR leadership roles, leading teams and advising executive-level leaders. Health care, pharma, and commercial backgrounds preferred.

We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Vantive, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $180,000 - $250,000 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. OmniSource

**Overview**
------------

Responsible for overall operations of the yard.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Make operational decisions within the yard that are consistent with the yard’s annual, monthly, and daily plan.
* Ensure compliance in safety, environmental, and personnel issues that may arise.

* Direct and manage yard operations for production, quality, shipping and receiving.
* Ensure operating expenses are consistent with the facility budgetary and fiscal performance goals. Develop and control budgets and operation plans.

* Manage yard inventory.
* Evaluate, order new and/or replacement equipment as required.
* Control and manage labor overtime.

------------------

* Minimum of three years supervisory experience.
* Experience with ferrous and non-ferrous scrap metals.
* Strong written and verbal communications skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Excel.
* Working knowledge of budgets and financial statements.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent team building, problem solving, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to lead, develop and motivate employees.
* Ability to make quick decisions in an ever changing work environment.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field.
 

***Steel Dynamics, Inc., and all affiliated entities are equal opportunity employers.***

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Primo Brands is a leading branded beverage company in North America with a focus on healthy hydration. We are proud to offer an extensive and iconic portfolio of highly recognizable, sustainably sourced, and conveniently packaged branded beverages distributed across more than 150,000 retail outlets.

We are seeking a **Plant Manager**. Choose a career in Technical and Production and you'll be part of our Product Supply backbone and a crucial element of our success. Our factories are where our products start their journey to the customer. This area of Primo Brands offers you the chance to experience collaboration in its purest form as you work alongside a diverse range of highly motivated and passionate people in our factories spread across the nation. What you do will be fulfilling, impactful and meaningful - not least is you'll be helping to deliver healthy hydration to millions of thirsty customers. We'll make sure you have the strong leadership and clear direction you need to feel motivated and passionate about accomplishing great things. While you take pride in delivering an excellent performance, you'll see your contributions are recognized and rewarded with an outstanding level of support, training and benefits everything you need to grow and thrive in your career.

**Factory Location:** Lorton, VA 
**Compensation:** $144,380.40 - $176,284.80. This position is eligible for an annual bonus.

**Shift:**

**Health Benefits:** Medical, prescription, dental, vision, flexible spending account (FSA), dependent care flexible spending account (FSA), health savings account (HSA).

**Retirement/Investing:** 401K with a 5% match, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).

**Insurance:** Employee Life Insurance, short and long-term disability, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, spouse/domestic partner/child life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment.

**Other great benefits:** Employee discounts, save on auto, home, and pet insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation and sick time, 9 paid holidays and 3 paid floating holidays, paid leave for when you have a baby, adopt a child, or become a foster parent, legal services, identity theft protection, employee assistance program (EAP), adoption reimbursement benefit, FEDlogic, commuter benefits.

 

* Overall responsibility for total facility performance and metrics for this bottling and distribution facility.
* Spending time on the floor engaging with employees and overseeing plant operations.
* Responsible for P&L and customer satisfaction performance for the facility.
* Creating and maintaining a cohesive team of leaders and providing coaching and development.
* Serving as factory champion for national safety and quality programs and initiatives.
* Creating and maintaining a positive work environment for all employees.
* Leading and facilitating Primo Brands Continuous Excellence (BCE) and an upcoming Total Performance Management (TPM) implementation.
* Building effective relationships with other plant leaders and corporate team members.
* Ensuring compliance of operations with company policy and all Federal, State and local regulations.

 

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain or related field; Masters a plus.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing, including career progression and cross functional assignments and 5 or more years. serving as a department manager to a team of leaders and employees.
* Consumer products goods industry experience required, prior food or beverage preferred.
* Technical knowledge of manufacturing operations, warehousing, and distribution.
* Experience with Manufacturing Excellence.
* In-depth understanding of production support functions including budgeting, planning, safety, quality and human resources.
* Strong computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and ERP systems such as SAP.
* Ability to inspire passion and commitment and lead and facilitate operational and cultural change initiatives.
* Demonstrated track record at building a cohesive team and creating a positive work environment.
* Prior experience leading, coaching and developing a team and delivering performance metrics through others.
* Continuous improvement experience, specifically Six Sigma, Lean or TPM.
* Exceptional communication, relationship building and formal presentation skills.
* Demonstrates and models a high degree of honesty, integrity and personal character.

**If you're ready to embark on an exciting journey with Primo Brands, apply now!**

**Salary Range Disclaimer:** 
The salary range provided for this position is an approximation based on market research, internal compensation data and the candidate’s qualifications and experience. Final salary offers are determined through a comprehensive evaluation of candidate qualifications and may vary depending on factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location of the position. Other components of the compensation package, including benefits and bonuses, will also be considered. We are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, and we encourage open dialogue about compensation during the interview process.

Primo Brands’ established portfolio includes billion-dollar brands Poland Spring® and Pure Life®, premium brands like Saratoga® and Mountain Valley®, regional leaders such as Arrowhead®, Deer Park®, Ice Mountain® Ozarka®, and Zephyrhills®, purified brands, Primo Water® and Sparkletts®, and flavored and enhanced brands like Splash® and AC+ION®. Our extensive direct-to-consumer offerings and industry-leading line-up of innovative water dispensers create consumer connectivity through recurring water purchases across Water Direct, Water Exchange, and Water Refill.

At Primo Brands, our more than 11,000 associates are at the heart of what we do and deliver on our mission to provide healthy hydration to consumers wherever, however and whenever they want it. We believe in fostering a respectful culture, which values our associates who are deeply invested in quality hydration, our communities, and the sustainability of our packaging and water sources for generations to come.

Primo Brands is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

Candidates must possess strong English language skills to effectively communicate with customers and provide exceptional service. Proficiency in English is essential for understanding customer needs, resolving inquiries, and collaborating with team members.

new_roles.description:
Overview:

**WHO WE ARE**

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes. 
 
Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.

**TOTAL REWARDS**

Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more.

Expected salary range of $189,000 to $210,000, varies based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits package that includes bonus and 401(k).

Responsibilities:

**PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION**

Manage and oversee the safe, efficient and reliable operation of fossil or hydro station(s). Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local regulatory requirements, applicable industry technical standards and company policies. Operate the plant(s) in a manner that minimizes the cost of generation and maximizes profitability while maintaining the long-term viability of the station assets.

 

**PRIMARY DUTIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Ensure standards are established and implemented to provide a safe work environment.
* Effectively manage all resources to ensure generation of electricity in a timely and reliable manner at the direction of the Power Team.
* Maintain a positive work environment and good employee relations. Provide guidance for employee development opportunities and timely feedback regarding performance.
* Serve as a change agent for business initiatives, while assuring the human element is understood and considered
* Manage the station O&M and capital budgets to minimize costs and maximize profitability while ensuring the long-term viability of the assets.
* Ensure compliance with all federal, state and local regulatory requirements and maintain environmental stewardship.
* Maintain effective community relations to promote a positive image of the Company.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* BS in engineering or business
* Minimum of 10 years professional experience
* Minimum of 8 years power plant (or related) experience
* Minimum of 5 years supervisory/managerial experience
* Professional or technical level experience in a technical role at a power plant
* Operations
* At least 2 of the following: Corporate/Staff, Engineering, Maintenance, or Outage
* RHR Selection

Qualifications:

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Master's Degree in engineering, business or related field
* Multi-site experience
* Multi-departmental experience
* Collective bargaining experience

new_roles.description:
**Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.**
============================================================================================================================================

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. We play to win – adapting quickly in an everchanging world – and make smart choices to safeguard our business, our communities and the people we serve for generations to come. And we invest in our world-class team, empowering our colleagues to unpack their potential, because we believe when our people grow, so does our business.

To learn more about playing for Team Amcor, visit www.amcor.com I LinkedIn I Glassdoor I Facebook I YouTube

**Job Description**
===================

To manage and lead overall plant operations ensuring the achievement of plant targets for Safety, Quality, Service and Cost. This will be executed through providing strong leadership to the plant team and managing the systems, equipment, people and materials according to the established policies, procedures, specifications, and customer requirements. This individual reports directly to the Director-Manufacturing. The Plant Lead Team members will report directly to the Plant Manager (typically 6-10 direct reports) Scope for this Plant Manager role is a medium to large-sized facility with typically greater than 300 employees and mid to high-level complexity.

**WHAT YOU GET TO DO**

* Leads and drives plant safety culture and puts safety first in all responsibilities.
* Leads identification of opportunities and problem areas for targeted improvement by creating, reviewing and monitoring data or reports that show performance to KPI's. (specifically, safety, quality, waste, and productivity)
* Oversees all aspects of human capital planning & management for the facility, including HC goal setting, improvement targets for KPI's, salary planning, performance management.
* Attract, hire, develop direct reports and create strong succession plans
* Ensure compliance with department safety, product safety, fire protection, Company polices/procedures, and housekeeping programs.
* Ensures effective, timely and well-developed communications for all product associates.
* Manage process control initiatives by ensuring manufacturing SOP's exist, and that they are sufficient for quality, safety, and process control.
* Leads plant budgeting processes
* Ensures execution of plant Cap-Ex
* Lead and ensure growth of CI culture by providing resources, participating in teams, and leading teams as necessary.
* Ensures facility compliance with local, state and federal regulatory agencies.
* Drives employee engagement action planning for the facility
* Leads communication to all plant associates regarding business needs and results
* Leads efforts at Best Practice sharing with other facilities
* Meets safety targets and drives a safety culture and environment to send every employee home everyday without injury.
* Meets or exceeds plant business plan and KPI’s.
* Delivers on established budget.
* Best Practices leadership
* Effective, cost-efficient planning and utilization of manpower, materials and machinery.
* Strong Human Capital planning, development and management for the facility.
* Drives High Performance Culture
* Plant talent to deliver on plan

 **WHAT WE VALUE**
* Strong financial acumen
* Results Orientation / Delivers on Plan
* Team Leadership
* Develops Organizational Capability
* Strategic Orientation / Enterprise Thinker
* Collaboration & Influence
* Change Leadership
* Facility Business Acumen/Market Knowledge

**WHAT WE WANT FROM YOU**

* A Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, or related field
* 10+ years of relevant experience in a production environment
* Demonstrated passion for safety
* 7+ years of leadership experience, preferably in flexible packaging
* Lives Amcor Values and leads by example
* Proven ability to lead and drive continuous improvement
* Strong Customer Service mindset
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated knowledge of BNA customers and plant capabilities
* Demonstrated understanding of drivers of plant results, including ability to interpret financial results
* Demonstrated CI knowledge, Six Sigma Black Belt certification strongly preferred

**Our Expectations**
====================

We expect our people to be guided by The Amcor Way and demonstrate our Values every day to enable the business to win. We are winning when:

* Our people are engaged and developing as part of a high-performing Amcor team
* Our customers grow and prosper from Amcor’s quality, service, and innovation
* Our investors benefit from Amcor’s consistent growth and superior returns
* The environment is better off because of Amcor’s leadership and products

**Equal Opportunity** **Employer/Minorities/Females/Disabled/Veterans/Sexual** **Orientation/Gender Identity**
==============================================================================================================

Amcor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you would like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant under the law, please click on the *"Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal" Poster*. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please call 224-313-7000 and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.

**E-Verify**
============

We verify the identity and employment authorization of individuals hired for employment in the United States.

**Compensation**
================

The starting salary for this position is expected to be between $176,100 to $242,100 depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Base pay information is based on national averages and a geographic differential may be applied based on work location. Position may also be eligible for Amcor’s Management Incentive Plan / Sales Incentive Plan, which is an annual bonus program based on business and individual performance, as well as medical coverage and other health and welfare benefits. The salary range provided reflects the anticipated starting salary base pay for this role at the time of this posting and does not necessarily reflect full earning potential over the course of employment. This range is applicable to positions performed in jurisdictions with pay transparency requirements, including CA, CO, CT, HI, IL, MD, MA, MN, NV, NJ, NY, RI, VT, WA, Washington DC, as well as remote roles that may be performed in these locations. Compensation for roles performed outside of these jurisdictions may vary. The Company reserves the right to modify this range at any time.

**Benefits**
============

When you join Amcor, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits and compensation package that includes:

* Medical, dental and vision plans
* Flexible time off, starting at 80 hours paid time per year for full-time salaried employees
* Company-paid holidays starting at 8 days per year and may vary by location
* Wellbeing program & Employee Assistance Program
* Health Savings Account/Flexible Spending Account
* Life insurance, AD&D, short-term & long-term disability, and voluntary benefits
* Paid Parental Leave
* Retirement Savings Plan with company match
* Tuition Reimbursement (dependent upon approval)
* Discretionary annual bonus program (initial eligibility dependent upon hire date)

new_roles.title: Stone Quarry Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
We are seeking an experienced and results-driven **Quarry Plant Manager** to oversee the daily operations of our aggregate production facility. In this role, you will be fully responsible for production efficiency, safety compliance, financial budgeting, and team leadership. You will manage the entire lifecycle of stone processing—from extraction and blasting coordination to crushing, screening, and stockpiling—while ensuring a safe and profitable operation.Key Responsibilities

* **Production & Optimization:** Oversee daily plant operations to meet production targets. Optimize the layout and throughput of fixed plant equipment (jaw/cone crushers, screens, conveyors) to maximize tons-per-hour output. **Hands On Lead from the front position**
* **Safety & Regulatory Compliance:** Enforce a strict culture of safety. Maintain total compliance with all local, state, and federal regulations, with primary emphasis on **MSHA mandates** and environmental permits (dust, water runoff, and noise).
* **Maintenance Oversight:** Lead the maintenance to plan and execute preventative maintenance schedules for all fixed and mobile assets (loaders, haul trucks, excavators), minimizing unscheduled downtime.
* **Team Leadership:** Hire, train, and manage a diverse workforce, including equipment operators, mechanics, and scale clerks. Promote a respectful, high-performance team environment.

new_roles.title: Senior Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
The Senior Director of Operations oversees all aspects of operations and provides leadership to the plant managers across multiple sites in a campus environment. Overall responsibility for Production, Maintenance, Personnel Scheduling, and Safety, as well as associated responsibilities in Warehouse Operations, Quality Assurance, Human Resources, Commercialization and other related areas. The Director of Operations is also responsible for establishing the campus culture, servicing business needs, and the 3-year masterplan that delivers all KPIs of Safety, Quality, Customer Service and Cost control.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Direct and oversee ongoing performance and efficiency of all plant functions through the establishment and monitoring of KPI's that seek to meet and/or exceed corporate objectives.
* Develop and mentor plant teams, future leaders, and succession planning by partnering with plant managers and human resources.
* Responsible for strategy development based on customer support, OpEx, return on capital, transformational goals, increasing capacity and throughput and cost discipline.
* Formulates and implements manufacturing programs to maintain and improve the competitive position and profitability of the operations. Set structure and discipline in daily management and utilizing data and KPI's to drive priorities and decisions.
* Sets Fiscal Year and 90-day priorities for the plants.
* Rapidly communicate to Vice President of Operations any significant challenges or failures that may pose a risk to the business.
* Leads the development and implementation of TPM strategies that maximize operational effectiveness/performance while partnering with other divisions to develop actionable plans to improve overall operational effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to drive continuous improvement in safety, productivity, product quality, customer service, quality of work life, and lowering manufacturing costs.
* Works closely with sales and finance teams to ensure seamless start-ups of new products on-time and at optimized costs.
* Role models ownership, collaboration, and disciplined execution.
* Provides support and guidance in the management of product quality and ensures compliance with quality and sanitation policies, procedures, and systems to include HACCP, GMPs and the management and reduction of consumer complaints.
* Ensures all performance issues are addressed in a timely manner and all employees adhere to company policies and procedures on an ongoing basis.
* Ensure compliance with all FDA, OSHA, local regulatory agencies and auditing requirements.

Other duties as assigned

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or manufacturing or related field of study.
* Experience with plant transformation including organizational design, facility enhancement and upskilling and development of the workforce. Track record of delivering significant business KPI goals in turnaround opportunities.
* Proven leadership skills to put employees first, ability to remove barriers and promote succession planning
* Directly supervise a team of leaders who supervise leaders.
* Able to simply and effectively communicate complex issues up, down and across the organization.
* High degree of financial acumen is required with the ability to perform plant-level financial analysis.
* Self-motivated with excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Computer skills including MS Office programs such as Outlook, Word, Excel PowerPoint.
* Strong analytical / problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Ability to empower, motivate and inspire staff.
* Ability to lead change and execute strategic decisions.

**Preferred:**

* MBA preferred, but not required
* TPM, TQM, IWS, Six Sigma, or Lean Manufacturing experience
* Organizational Performance Design capability

**Work Environment:**

* This position works in both office AND manufacturing floor environments.
* Evening and weekend work may be required on an as needed basis
* Travel up to 30%

*Tandem Foods is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

 
 
Compensation: $201,500.00 - $277,000.00
